play.how: Swipe the board, use the arrow keys, or tap the arrows.
play.hubIntro: Quick games with a salon twist. Pick one to start.
game.merge.title: Merge
game.merge.line: Slide and merge salon items up to looksmenu.
game.merge.r1: Swipe the board, press the arrow keys, or tap the arrows. Every tile slides as far as it can.
game.merge.r2: Two matching items that touch merge into the next one in the chain, and you score points.
game.merge.r3: After every move a new tile appears. Keep merging so the board does not fill up.
game.merge.r4: Reach the looksmenu tile to win. The game ends when no move is left.
game.merge.r5: Undo takes back your last move. New game starts again.
game.memory.title: Memory Match
game.memory.r1: Tap a card to turn it over, then tap a second card.
game.memory.r2: If the two cards match, they stay open. If not, they turn back.
game.memory.r3: Find all 8 pairs in as few moves as you can. Your best score is saved on this phone.
game.quiz.title: Name That Style
game.quiz.line: Guess the haircut from its photo.
game.quiz.r1: You get 10 photos from the catalogue, one at a time.
game.quiz.r2: Pick the right name from four choices.
game.quiz.r3: You see the answer straight away. Each right answer is one point.
game.quiz.r4: A wrong answer is fine: it is a good way to learn the names.
quiz.question: Which style is this?
game.rush.title: Barber Shop Rush
game.rush.line: Serve customers before they lose patience.
game.rush.r1: Customers line up with a request: haircut, beard trim, colour, facial or nails.
game.rush.r2: Tap the matching service button to serve the one who asked. The fresher the customer, the more points.
game.rush.r3: Serve one after another to build a combo bonus. The shop gets busier every five customers.
game.rush.r4: A customer who waits too long leaves, and a wrong tap costs a heart too. Three hearts and the shop closes.
game.sculptor.title: Fade & Beard Sculptor
game.sculptor.line: Trim the beard to match the style.
game.sculptor.r1: Look at the target style at the top. Each square is a patch of hair.
game.sculptor.r2: Pick a clipper length: shave, short, medium or long.
game.sculptor.r3: Tap or drag across the squares to trim them, and match the target as closely as you can.
game.sculptor.r4: Tap Check to see your score. Three stars means a near-perfect match.
rush.hint: Tap Open the shop to start. Tap the service each customer asks for.
sculptor.board: Beard board: tap or drag to trim
game.runner.title: Style Runner
game.runner.line: Run, jump and collect scissors to reach the mirror.
game.runner.r1: Run along the shop floor. Use the arrow keys or A and D to move, and the up arrow, W or Space to jump. On a phone, use the buttons under the picture.
game.runner.r2: Collect the scissors for 10 points each.
game.runner.r3: Jump on top of tangled hair to clear it for 100 points. Touch it from the side and you lose a heart.
game.runner.r4: Do not fall into the gaps between the floors. A fall also costs a heart, and you restart at the last floor you reached.
game.runner.r5: Reach the looksmenu mirror at the far end to win. You score bonus points for every heart you have left.
runner.canvas: Style Runner game: a stylist runs and jumps along a salon floor
runner.hint: Move with the arrow keys or the buttons. Jump on tangled hair and grab the scissors.
game.match.title: Style Match
game.match.line: Swap salon items to match three or more.
game.match.r1: Tap a tile, then tap a tile next to it to swap them. You can also swipe a tile toward its neighbour.
game.match.r2: Line up three or more of the same item in a row or a column to clear them. Longer lines score more.
game.match.r3: A swap that makes no match slides back and does not use a move.
game.match.r4: New tiles drop in as others clear. Chains that start by themselves score extra.
game.match.r5: Reach the level goal before your moves run out to move up a level. If no swaps are left, the board is dealt again.
match.hint: Tap a tile, then a neighbour, or swipe.
match.noMatch: No match there. Try another swap.
match.shuffled: No swaps left. A fresh board is dealt.

addon.face-wash-cleansing.name: Face Wash & Cleansing
addon.face-wash-cleansing.line: A deep clean for city dust and oil.
addon.face-wash-cleansing.what: Your face is washed with a mild cleanser and a gentle massage, then wiped clean and toned.
addon.face-wash-cleansing.why1: Dust and pollution settle into the pores every day.
addon.face-wash-cleansing.why2: Oil and sweat build up and can lead to spots.
addon.face-wash-cleansing.why3: Clean skin makes a shave smoother and a style look fresher.
addon.face-wash-cleansing.now: Skin feels clean, light and fresh.
addon.face-wash-cleansing.later: Fewer clogged pores and a more even look, with regular cleansing.
addon.face-wash-cleansing.good: Oily or dusty skin, daily commuters, before a shave or an event.
addon.face-wash-cleansing.ask: you have open spots, sunburn, or an allergy to cleansers.
addon.face-wash-cleansing.often: Every 2–3 weeks, or with each haircut
addon.scrub.name: Scrub (Exfoliation)
addon.scrub.line: Removes dead skin for a smoother face.
addon.scrub.what: A gentle scrub is massaged over the face to lift dead skin, then rinsed off.
addon.scrub.why1: Dead skin builds up and makes the face look dull.
addon.scrub.why2: It can trap hairs under the skin, especially under a beard.
addon.scrub.why3: Smooth skin takes a shave and skin products better.
addon.scrub.now: Skin feels smooth and looks brighter.
addon.scrub.later: Fewer ingrown hairs and a smoother shave.
addon.scrub.good: Dull or rough skin, bearded men, ingrown hairs.
addon.scrub.ask: you have acne flare-ups, sunburn or very sensitive skin.
addon.steam-blackhead.name: Steam & Blackhead Removal
addon.steam-blackhead.line: Opens the pores so they can be cleaned.
addon.steam-blackhead.what: Warm steam softens the skin and opens the pores, then blackheads and whiteheads are gently cleared.
addon.steam-blackhead.why1: Blocked pores show up as blackheads on the nose and chin.
addon.steam-blackhead.why2: Steam softens the skin so cleaning is gentler.
addon.steam-blackhead.why3: Leaving them can lead to bigger spots.
addon.steam-blackhead.now: Nose and chin look clearer and skin feels fresh.
addon.steam-blackhead.later: Pores look cleaner with regular care.
addon.steam-blackhead.ask: you have active acne, broken skin, or very red or sensitive skin.
addon.facial.name: Facial
addon.facial.line: A full skin treatment: cleanse, massage, mask.
addon.facial.what: A step-by-step treatment: cleanse, scrub, steam, massage, mask and moisturise.
addon.facial.why1: A daily face wash only does so much; a facial cares for the whole skin.
addon.facial.why2: The massage relaxes the face and improves how skin looks.
addon.facial.why3: Moisturising protects skin from dry air and dust.
addon.facial.now: Skin feels soft, hydrated and calm.
addon.facial.later: Skin looks healthier and more even over time.
addon.facial.good: Dry, tired or dull skin; before weddings and festivals.
addon.facial.ask: you have sunburn, open cuts or a skin infection.
addon.glow-facial.name: Glow Facial
addon.glow-facial.line: A brightening facial for a fresh, even glow.
addon.glow-facial.what: A facial with brightening products, such as vitamin C, to lift dullness and even out tone.
addon.glow-facial.why1: Sun and dust make skin look tired and uneven.
addon.glow-facial.why2: A brighter face looks good in photos and on special days.
addon.glow-facial.why3: It gets skin ready for the wedding and festival season.
addon.glow-facial.now: Skin looks brighter and feels fresh.
addon.glow-facial.later: Tone looks more even over a few weeks, with sun care. Results vary.
addon.glow-facial.good: Dull skin, uneven tone, before weddings and photos.
addon.glow-facial.ask: you have sunburn, skin allergies or very sensitive skin.
addon.glow-facial.often: Every 4 weeks, or before big events
addon.de-tan.name: De-Tan
addon.de-tan.line: Eases sun tan on the face and neck.
addon.de-tan.what: A de-tan pack is applied to the face and neck to ease sun tan, then washed off.
addon.de-tan.why1: Strong sun leaves a tan on the face and neck.
addon.de-tan.why2: A tan makes skin look uneven and dull.
addon.de-tan.why3: Easing it helps the face and neck match.
addon.de-tan.now: Skin looks a little brighter and more even.
addon.de-tan.later: Tan eases gradually with repeat care and sunscreen.
addon.de-tan.good: A sun-tanned face and neck, riders, outdoor workers.
addon.de-tan.ask: you have sunburn or broken skin.
addon.clay-mask.name: Clay Mask
addon.clay-mask.line: Draws out oil and tightens the look of pores.
addon.clay-mask.what: A clay or charcoal mask is spread over the face, left to dry, then washed off.
addon.clay-mask.why1: Oily skin turns shiny and breaks out.
addon.clay-mask.why2: A mask pulls out extra oil and dirt.
addon.clay-mask.why3: Pores look tighter and the face looks matte.
addon.clay-mask.now: Skin feels tight, clean and matte.
addon.clay-mask.ask: your skin is dry, very sensitive or broken.
addon.face-massage.name: Face Massage
addon.face-massage.line: Relaxes the face and wakes up tired skin.
addon.face-massage.what: A gentle massage with cream or oil across the forehead, cheeks, jaw and neck.
addon.face-massage.why1: Tired, tense muscles make the face look heavy.
addon.face-massage.why2: Massage helps blood flow, so skin looks livelier.
addon.face-massage.why3: It is a good break after a long day.
addon.face-massage.now: Face feels relaxed and skin looks livelier.
addon.face-massage.later: A relaxed face and better colour for a day or two.
addon.face-massage.good: Stress, long working hours, tired skin.
addon.face-massage.ask: you have a fever, a skin infection or a recent injury.
addon.head-massage.name: Head Massage
addon.head-massage.line: Eases tension and relaxes the scalp.
addon.head-massage.what: A firm, relaxing massage of the scalp, neck and shoulders, usually with oil.
addon.head-massage.why1: Long hours and stress build tension in the head and neck.
addon.head-massage.why2: Massage gets blood moving to the scalp.
addon.head-massage.why3: It is a quiet, relaxing end to a haircut.
addon.head-massage.now: Head and shoulders feel light and relaxed.
addon.head-massage.later: Easier sleep and less tension for the rest of the day.
addon.head-massage.good: Tension headaches, stress, a dry scalp.
addon.head-massage.ask: you have a fever, scalp wounds or a skin infection.
addon.hair-spa.name: Hair Spa
addon.hair-spa.line: Deep conditioning for dry, rough hair.
addon.hair-spa.what: Hair is washed, a deep conditioning mask is applied with steam, and then rinsed.
addon.hair-spa.why1: Dust, sun and heat leave hair dry and rough.
addon.hair-spa.why2: Colour, bleach and perms dry hair even more.
addon.hair-spa.why3: A spa puts back moisture and softness.
addon.hair-spa.now: Hair feels soft, smooth and shiny.
addon.hair-spa.later: Less frizz and breakage for a few weeks.
addon.hair-spa.good: Dry, frizzy, coloured or permed hair.
addon.hair-spa.ask: you have scalp wounds or a skin infection.
addon.hair-spa.often: Every 3–4 weeks; every 2 weeks after colour
addon.beard-spa.name: Beard Spa
addon.beard-spa.line: Cleans, softens and conditions the beard.
addon.beard-spa.what: The beard is washed, steamed, conditioned and oiled, then combed into shape.
addon.beard-spa.why1: The skin under a beard gets dry and itchy, and a beard holds dirt.
addon.beard-spa.why2: Conditioning makes the hair soft and easy to shape.
addon.beard-spa.why3: A healthy beard grows fuller and looks neater.
addon.beard-spa.now: The beard feels soft and smells fresh; the skin underneath feels calmer.
addon.beard-spa.later: Less itch and flaking, and an easier beard to style.
addon.beard-spa.ask: you have a skin infection or open sores under the beard.
addon.brow-grooming.name: Eyebrow & Ear-Nose Grooming
addon.brow-grooming.line: Tidy brows and trimmed ear and nose hair.
addon.brow-grooming.what: Eyebrows are shaped with threading or a trimmer, and ear and nose hair is trimmed.
addon.brow-grooming.why1: Untidy brows and stray hair make a good cut look unfinished.
addon.brow-grooming.why3: It takes minutes and changes the whole face.
addon.brow-grooming.now: The face looks tidy and awake.
addon.brow-grooming.good: Bushy or uneven brows, stray hair.
addon.brow-grooming.ask: you have a skin infection near the eyes.

wsvc.layered-cut.name: Layered Cut
wsvc.layered-cut.line: Soft layers for movement and shape.
wsvc.layered-cut.what: Hair is cut in layers of different lengths so it falls with body and movement instead of hanging flat.
wsvc.layered-cut.good: Long or medium hair that feels heavy or flat.
wsvc.bob-cut.name: Bob Cut
wsvc.bob-cut.line: A neat cut from chin to shoulder.
wsvc.bob-cut.what: A clean, blunt or softly layered cut that ends between the chin and the shoulders.
wsvc.bob-cut.good: A fresh, low-effort look for straight or wavy hair.
wsvc.step-cut.name: Step Cut
wsvc.step-cut.line: Clear steps that frame the face.
wsvc.step-cut.what: Hair is cut in visible steps from the front to the back, adding shape and volume.
wsvc.step-cut.good: Medium to long hair that needs volume.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.name: Fringe & Bangs
wsvc.fringe-bangs.line: A fresh front that frames the face.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.what: A fringe is cut or trimmed to sit on the forehead, straight or side-swept.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.good: A quick change that softens the forehead.
wsvc.blow-dry.name: Blow Dry & Styling
wsvc.blow-dry.what: Hair is washed and blow dried with a brush, then finished straight, curled or wavy.
wsvc.blow-dry.good: Parties, work days or a quick fresh-up.
wcat.hair-colour.label: Hair colour
wcat.hair-colour.intro: From grey cover to bold shades.
wsvc.global-colour.name: Global Colour
wsvc.global-colour.what: A single shade is applied from roots to ends for an even, rich colour.
wsvc.global-colour.good: Covering grey or changing your natural shade.
wsvc.highlights.name: Highlights
wsvc.highlights.what: Thin streaks of a lighter shade are placed through the hair to add light and depth.
wsvc.balayage.name: Balayage
wsvc.balayage.line: Soft, sun-kissed colour blended by hand.
wsvc.balayage.what: Colour is painted by hand from darker roots to lighter ends, with no hard line.
wsvc.root-touch-up.name: Root Touch-Up
wsvc.root-touch-up.line: Covers new growth and grey at the roots.
wsvc.root-touch-up.what: Colour is applied only to the new growth at the roots to match the rest of the hair.
wsvc.root-touch-up.good: Grey roots or a colour that has grown out.
wsvc.fashion-colour.name: Fashion Colour
wsvc.fashion-colour.line: Bold shades like wine, plum or blue.
wsvc.fashion-colour.what: Hair is lightened if needed and coloured with a bold, non-natural shade.
wcat.hair-care.label: Hair treatments
wsvc.hair-spa.name: Hair Spa
wsvc.hair-spa.what: A wash, a deep conditioning mask with steam, then a rinse.
wsvc.keratin.name: Keratin Treatment
wsvc.keratin.what: A keratin formula is applied and sealed with heat, leaving hair smooth and shiny.
wsvc.smoothening.name: Smoothening
wsvc.smoothening.what: A smoothening cream relaxes frizz so hair is softer and easier to manage, with natural movement.
wsvc.smoothening.good: Frizzy or unruly hair you want easier to handle.
wsvc.rebonding.name: Rebonding
wsvc.rebonding.what: Hair is straightened with a cream and heat so it stays poker straight until it grows out.
wsvc.rebonding.good: Very curly or wavy hair you want straight.
wsvc.rebonding.often: Touch up new growth every 4–6 months
wsvc.scalp-treatment.name: Scalp Treatment
wsvc.scalp-treatment.what: A scalp cleanse and treatment that helps with dandruff and an oily or itchy scalp.
wcat.brows.label: Eyebrows & threading
wcat.brows.intro: Neat brows and a clean face.
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.name: Eyebrow Threading
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.what: Brows are shaped with a thread, removing stray hair for a neat line.
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.good: Any face; a tidy base for makeup.
wsvc.upper-lip.name: Upper Lip Threading
wsvc.upper-lip.what: Fine hair above the lip is removed with a thread.
wsvc.forehead.name: Forehead Threading
wsvc.forehead.what: Fine hair along the forehead is removed with a thread to clean the hairline.
wsvc.full-face-threading.name: Full Face Threading
wsvc.full-face-threading.what: Brows, upper lip, forehead, cheeks and chin are threaded in one go.
wsvc.full-face-threading.good: A full-face fresh-up before an event.
wsvc.brow-tint.name: Eyebrow Shaping & Tint
wsvc.brow-tint.what: Brows are shaped, then tinted a shade that suits your hair so they look fuller.

wsvc.fruit-facial.what: A gentle facial with fruit-based products to cleanse and refresh the skin.
wsvc.detan-facial.name: D-Tan Facial
wsvc.detan-facial.what: A facial with a de-tan pack to ease sun tan and dull skin.
wsvc.insta-glow.name: Insta Glow Facial
wsvc.insta-glow.what: A short brightening facial to give skin a fresh glow.
wsvc.gold-facial.name: Gold Facial
wsvc.gold-facial.line: A rich facial for a radiant finish.
wsvc.gold-facial.what: A premium facial with gold-based products and massage, for a rich, radiant look.

wguide.facial-how-often.title: How often should you get a facial?
wguide.facial-how-often.answer: Every 4–6 weeks suits most skin, about one skin cycle between visits.
wguide.facial-how-often.tip1: Oily or dusty skin: every 3–4 weeks.
wguide.facial-how-often.tip2: Dry or sensitive skin: every 5–6 weeks, with gentler products.
wguide.facial-how-often.tip3: Before a big event: book 2–3 days ahead, not on the day.
wguide.facial-how-often.tip4: Between facials: wash twice a day and use a moisturiser with sunscreen in the morning.
wguide.colour-salon-or-home.title: Hair colour: salon or home?
wguide.colour-salon-or-home.answer: Home colour can work for covering grey with a dark shade. Going lighter or trying highlights is safer in a salon.
wguide.colour-salon-or-home.tip1: Do a patch test 48 hours before any colour.
wguide.colour-salon-or-home.tip2: Going lighter than your natural colour needs bleach, which is best left to a stylist.
wguide.colour-salon-or-home.tip3: Fashion shades fade fast, so plan a refresh every 3–4 weeks.
wguide.colour-salon-or-home.tip4: Use a colour-safe shampoo and cool water to keep the shade longer.
wguide.waxing-aftercare.title: Looking after your skin after waxing
wguide.waxing-aftercare.answer: For the first 24 hours, keep waxed skin cool, clean and out of the sun.
wguide.waxing-aftercare.tip1: Avoid hot showers, steam, saunas and swimming for 24 hours.
wguide.waxing-aftercare.tip2: Do not scrub, and skip heavily perfumed lotions on waxed skin that day.
wguide.waxing-aftercare.tip3: Wear loose clothes so the waxed skin is not rubbed.
wguide.waxing-aftercare.tip4: Exfoliate gently from the third day to help prevent ingrown hairs.
wguide.keratin-aftercare.title: Making keratin and smoothening last
wguide.keratin-aftercare.answer: Keep hair dry and straight for the first 2–3 days and use a sulphate-free shampoo after that.
wguide.keratin-aftercare.tip1: Do not tie, clip or tuck hair behind your ears for 2–3 days.
wguide.keratin-aftercare.tip2: Do not wash your hair for the first 72 hours, or as your stylist advises.
wguide.keratin-aftercare.tip3: Use a sulphate-free shampoo and a conditioner from then on.
wguide.keratin-aftercare.tip4: Avoid chlorinated pools without a cap, and book a hair spa between treatments.
wguide.brow-shape.title: Which eyebrow shape suits your face?
wguide.brow-shape.answer: Soft, natural arches suit most faces. Ask the stylist to shape around your natural line.
wguide.brow-shape.tip1: Round face: a slightly higher arch adds length.
wguide.brow-shape.tip2: Long face: a flatter, softer brow adds width.
wguide.brow-shape.tip3: Square face: a soft curve balances a strong jaw.
wguide.brow-shape.tip4: Do not over-thin: brows grow back slowly. Thread every 2–3 weeks to keep the line.
wguide.wedding-prep.title: Skin and hair prep before a wedding
wguide.wedding-prep.answer: Start 3–4 weeks ahead: a facial, a hair spa, and a trial for makeup and hairstyle.
wguide.wedding-prep.tip1: 4 weeks before: book bridal makeup and a trial.
wguide.wedding-prep.tip2: 3 weeks before: a facial and a hair spa, and no new products.
wguide.wedding-prep.tip3: 1 week before: threading, waxing and a manicure. Colour hair at least a week ahead.
wguide.wedding-prep.tip4: The day before: rest, drink water and try nothing new on your skin.
wsvc.layered-cut.why: Layers remove weight so hair moves, holds a blow-dry and looks fuller at the ends.
wsvc.layered-cut.step1: We look at your hair type, parting and face shape, and agree the length.
wsvc.layered-cut.step2: Hair is cut in sections, longest layer first, then blended.
wsvc.layered-cut.step3: We dry and style it so you see how it falls.
wsvc.layered-cut.suits: Long or medium hair that feels flat or heavy; works on straight, wavy and curly hair.
wsvc.layered-cut.ask: your hair is very fine and you want to keep every inch of length.
wsvc.layered-cut.care: Trim every 8–10 weeks. Use a heat protectant when styling.
wsvc.bob-cut.why: A bob is low-maintenance, frames the face and shows off the neck and jawline.
wsvc.bob-cut.step1: We agree the length (chin, above or below) and the shape (blunt, soft or A-line).
wsvc.bob-cut.step2: Hair is sectioned and cut from the nape up for a clean line.
wsvc.bob-cut.step3: The finish is checked dry so both sides match.
wsvc.bob-cut.suits: Straight and slightly wavy hair; oval, heart and long faces.
wsvc.bob-cut.ask: your hair is very curly or you may want long hair again soon.
wsvc.bob-cut.care: Re-shape every 5–6 weeks to keep the line sharp.
wsvc.step-cut.why: Steps give a visible, playful shape and add body to long hair without losing length.
wsvc.step-cut.step1: We choose how many steps and where the first one starts.
wsvc.step-cut.step2: The front sections are cut in clear steps; the back is kept longer.
wsvc.step-cut.step3: We blow-dry to show the step lines.
wsvc.step-cut.suits: Long, thick or straight hair that needs shape.
wsvc.step-cut.ask: your hair is thin or damaged at the ends.
wsvc.step-cut.care: Trim every 8 weeks. A little smoothing serum keeps the ends neat.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.why: A fringe frames the eyes and can soften a high forehead.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.step1: We check your forehead, hair growth and cowlick, then choose the fringe style.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.step2: The fringe is cut dry in small cuts so it does not end up too short.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.step3: We style it and show you how to dry it.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.suits: Straight and wavy hair; round, long and square faces.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.ask: you have a strong cowlick or very curly hair at the front.
wsvc.fringe-bangs.care: Fringe grows fast: trim every 3–4 weeks. Wash it on its own if it gets oily.
wsvc.blow-dry.why: A blow-dry gives a smooth, polished finish for an event, photos or just a good day.
wsvc.blow-dry.step1: Hair is washed and lightly conditioned.
wsvc.blow-dry.step2: A heat protectant goes on, then we dry in sections with a round brush.
wsvc.blow-dry.step3: We finish with light spray or serum.
wsvc.blow-dry.suits: Anyone; it lasts 2–3 days on most hair.
wsvc.blow-dry.ask: you have a scalp rash or a very sensitive scalp.
wsvc.blow-dry.care: Sleep with the hair loosely tied and avoid washing for 2 days.
wsvc.global-colour.why: Even all-over colour covers grey and refreshes dull hair.
wsvc.global-colour.step1: We do a strand test and choose the shade with you.
wsvc.global-colour.step2: Colour is applied section by section from roots to ends.
wsvc.global-colour.step3: It is left to develop, rinsed, then conditioned.
wsvc.global-colour.suits: Grey cover or a full colour change on healthy hair.
wsvc.global-colour.ask: you are allergic to hair dye, your scalp is irritated or you coloured it very recently.
wsvc.global-colour.care: Use colour-safe shampoo and wait 48 hours before the first wash.
wsvc.highlights.why: Highlights add light and dimension without colouring all your hair.
wsvc.highlights.step1: We pick the shade and the thickness of the strands.
wsvc.highlights.step2: Sections are lightened with foils so the colour stays only where wanted.
wsvc.highlights.step3: We tone the lightened strands and condition.
wsvc.highlights.suits: Dark and medium hair that wants a lift.
wsvc.highlights.ask: your hair is already very dry or chemically straightened.
wsvc.highlights.care: Use a purple shampoo once a week and a weekly hair mask.
wsvc.balayage.why: Balayage grows out softly, so there is no harsh root line and less upkeep.
wsvc.balayage.step1: We plan where the light should fall to flatter your face.
wsvc.balayage.step2: Lightener is hand-painted on the hair for a natural fade.
wsvc.balayage.step3: We tone and condition, then dry.
wsvc.balayage.suits: Medium to long hair; a low-maintenance colour.
wsvc.balayage.ask: your hair is damaged or already lightened several times.
wsvc.balayage.care: Re-tone every 8–12 weeks. Use sulphate-free shampoo.
wsvc.root-touch-up.why: Roots show first. A touch-up keeps the colour fresh between full colours.
wsvc.root-touch-up.step1: We match the shade to the rest of your hair.
wsvc.root-touch-up.step2: Colour is applied only to new growth at the roots.
wsvc.root-touch-up.step3: It is rinsed and the roots blended into the lengths.
wsvc.root-touch-up.suits: Grey or regrowth at the parting.
wsvc.root-touch-up.ask: you are allergic to hair dye or have a scalp wound.
wsvc.root-touch-up.care: Repeat every 4–5 weeks. Wait 48 hours before washing.
wsvc.fashion-colour.why: Bold colours say something: fun, personal and photo-ready.
wsvc.fashion-colour.step1: Hair is usually lightened first, then we choose the colour.
wsvc.fashion-colour.step2: The fashion colour is applied evenly and left to develop.
wsvc.fashion-colour.step3: We rinse with cool water and condition.
wsvc.fashion-colour.suits: Healthy hair, and someone who is happy to maintain colour.
wsvc.fashion-colour.ask: your hair is damaged or you need a very natural look at work.
wsvc.fashion-colour.care: Wash less often with cool water; fashion colours fade faster.
wsvc.hair-spa.why: A hair spa feeds dry hair and scalp, so hair feels soft and healthy again.
wsvc.hair-spa.step1: We wash and gently massage the scalp.
wsvc.hair-spa.step2: A mask chosen for your hair is applied and steamed.
wsvc.hair-spa.suits: Dry, dull or frizzy hair, and tired scalp.
wsvc.hair-spa.ask: you have an open scalp wound or a severe scalp condition.
wsvc.hair-spa.care: Avoid washing for 24 hours and repeat every 3–4 weeks.
wsvc.keratin.why: Keratin smooths frizz and makes hair easier to manage for months.
wsvc.keratin.step1: We wash and check your hair texture.
wsvc.keratin.step2: The keratin product is applied and sealed with a flat iron.
wsvc.keratin.step3: We rinse after the set time and dry.
wsvc.keratin.suits: Frizzy, rough hair that you want smoother.
wsvc.keratin.ask: you are pregnant, or have a very damaged scalp.
wsvc.keratin.care: No washing for 3 days. Use sulphate-free shampoo to make it last.
wsvc.smoothening.why: Smoothening gives straighter, softer hair for 3–4 months with natural movement.
wsvc.smoothening.step1: We check your hair for damage and choose the right strength.
wsvc.smoothening.step2: The product is applied, left, then ironed in.
wsvc.smoothening.suits: Wavy and frizzy hair that wants a sleeker look.
wsvc.smoothening.ask: your hair is very damaged, thin or recently coloured.
wsvc.smoothening.care: No washing or tying hair tightly for 3 days. Use gentle shampoo.
wsvc.rebonding.why: Rebonding gives permanently straight hair; new growth comes in your natural texture.
wsvc.rebonding.step1: We test your hair and decide if it can take the process.
wsvc.rebonding.step2: A straightening cream is applied, rinsed, then ironed and set.
wsvc.rebonding.step3: The neutraliser is applied and the hair is washed and dried.
wsvc.rebonding.suits: Very curly or frizzy hair that wants to be stick straight.
wsvc.rebonding.ask: your hair is damaged, very thin or already treated a lot.
wsvc.rebonding.care: Do not wash or tie hair for 3 days; follow with a mask every week.
wsvc.scalp-treatment.why: A healthy scalp grows healthy hair. This targets dandruff, oil and itch.
wsvc.scalp-treatment.step1: We look at the scalp and ask about your concern.
wsvc.scalp-treatment.step2: A cleansing and treatment product is massaged in.
wsvc.scalp-treatment.step3: We rinse and finish with a soothing step.
wsvc.scalp-treatment.suits: Dandruff, oily or itchy scalp, and hair fall.
wsvc.scalp-treatment.ask: you have an open wound or sore on the scalp.
wsvc.scalp-treatment.care: Use the shampoo we recommend and avoid very hot water.
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.why: Clean, shaped brows open up the face and make makeup look better.
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.step1: We study your face and mark the shape.
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.step2: Threading removes stray hairs one line at a time.
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.step3: We soothe the skin with a cooling gel.
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.suits: Anyone who wants a neat natural shape.
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.ask: you use retinoid creams or have irritated skin on the brows.
wsvc.eyebrow-threading.care: Do not touch the area for a few hours; avoid heavy makeup the same day.
wsvc.upper-lip.why: Removes fine hair so the area looks smooth for makeup and photos.
wsvc.upper-lip.step1: We check the skin and growth.
wsvc.upper-lip.step2: Threading or wax is used as the skin allows.
wsvc.upper-lip.suits: Light to medium fine hair on the upper lip.
wsvc.upper-lip.ask: you have a cold sore or active pimples there.
wsvc.upper-lip.care: Avoid sun and heavy creams for the rest of the day.
wsvc.forehead.why: Cleans the hairline so the forehead looks smooth and makeup sits better.
wsvc.forehead.step1: We mark the line you want.
wsvc.forehead.step2: Fine hairs are threaded away along the hairline.
wsvc.forehead.suits: Fine hair along the forehead and temples.
wsvc.forehead.ask: the skin there is broken out or sore.
wsvc.forehead.care: Skip scrubs and strong actives for 24 hours.
wsvc.full-face-threading.why: Removes fine facial hair for a smooth base and a brighter look.
wsvc.full-face-threading.step1: We check the skin and plan the areas.
wsvc.full-face-threading.step2: Brows, upper lip, forehead, cheeks and chin are threaded.
wsvc.full-face-threading.step3: A soothing gel finishes the service.
wsvc.full-face-threading.suits: Anyone who wants a smooth face, especially before makeup or events.
wsvc.full-face-threading.ask: you have active acne, a sunburn or sore skin.
wsvc.full-face-threading.care: Do not scrub or use strong creams for a day.
wsvc.brow-tint.why: Tint darkens sparse or light brows so the shape looks full and defined.
wsvc.brow-tint.step1: We choose a shade a little lighter than your hair.
wsvc.brow-tint.step2: Tint is brushed on and left for a few minutes.
wsvc.brow-tint.step3: It is wiped off and the shape tidied.
wsvc.brow-tint.ask: you are allergic to hair dye or have eye irritation.
wsvc.brow-tint.care: Keep the brows dry for 24 hours; the tint lasts 3–4 weeks.
wsvc.fruit-facial.why: A gentle facial that cleans and refreshes, good for everyday skin.
wsvc.fruit-facial.step1: We cleanse and check your skin type.
wsvc.fruit-facial.step2: We scrub lightly, steam, and massage in the fruit cream.
wsvc.fruit-facial.step3: A mask and moisturiser finish it.
wsvc.fruit-facial.suits: Normal and dull skin that needs a refresh.
wsvc.fruit-facial.ask: you have active acne, a rash or a fresh sunburn.
wsvc.fruit-facial.care: Skip heavy makeup for 6 hours and wear sunscreen.
wsvc.detan-facial.why: Lifts sun tan and dullness so skin tone looks clearer.
wsvc.detan-facial.step1: We cleanse and apply the de-tan product on the face.
wsvc.detan-facial.step2: It is massaged in and left to work.
wsvc.detan-facial.step3: We remove it and apply a calming mask.
wsvc.detan-facial.suits: Tanned, uneven or dull skin after sun or travel.
wsvc.detan-facial.ask: you have sunburn, open skin or a known allergy.
wsvc.detan-facial.care: Wear sunscreen daily; results last longer with sun care.
wsvc.insta-glow.why: A quick brightening facial for a glow before photos or an event.
wsvc.insta-glow.step2: A brightening serum and massage go on.
wsvc.insta-glow.step3: A mask and moisturiser finish the glow.
wsvc.insta-glow.suits: Tired or dull skin that needs a quick lift.
wsvc.insta-glow.ask: you have very sensitive skin or an active breakout.
wsvc.gold-facial.why: A richer facial with a gold-infused mask for a warm, bright finish.
wsvc.gold-facial.step2: The gold cream is massaged in and a mask is set.
wsvc.gold-facial.suits: Mature or dull skin before a celebration.
wsvc.gold-facial.ask: you have very oily or acne-prone skin.
wsvc.gold-facial.care: Avoid scrubs and harsh products for 2–3 days.
wsvc.korean-glow.why: A layered routine that leaves skin hydrated, soft and dewy.
wsvc.korean-glow.step1: Double cleansing removes oil, sunscreen and makeup.
wsvc.korean-glow.step2: A gentle exfoliation, then a hydrating essence and massage.
wsvc.korean-glow.step3: A sheet mask and moisturiser seal in the glow.
wsvc.korean-glow.suits: Dry, tired or dull skin that likes a dewy finish.
wsvc.korean-glow.ask: you have very oily skin or active breakouts.
wsvc.korean-glow.care: Keep using a light moisturiser and sunscreen to hold the glow.
wsvc.underarms.why: Removes hair for a smooth, clean look, and lasts longer than shaving.
wsvc.underarms.step1: We check the skin and trim long hair.
wsvc.underarms.step2: Warm wax is applied and removed quickly.
wsvc.underarms.step3: We soothe with gel or lotion.
wsvc.underarms.suits: Anyone who wants smooth skin for weeks.
wsvc.underarms.ask: you have a rash, a cut or active irritation.
wsvc.underarms.care: No deodorant or hot showers for 24 hours; wear loose cotton.
wsvc.full-arms.why: Smooth arms look neat, especially in sleeveless wear.
wsvc.full-arms.step1: We clean the skin and test the wax temperature.
wsvc.full-arms.step2: Wax is applied in small sections and removed against growth.
wsvc.full-arms.suits: Hair that has grown at least a quarter inch.
wsvc.full-arms.ask: you have sunburn, cuts or recent skin peels.
wsvc.full-arms.care: Avoid sun, saunas and scrubs for a day. Moisturise.
wsvc.half-legs.why: A tidy lower leg for skirts, dresses and everyday comfort.
wsvc.half-legs.step1: We prepare the skin and test the wax.
wsvc.half-legs.step2: Wax is applied below the knee and removed in sections.
wsvc.half-legs.suits: Anyone who wants smooth lower legs.
wsvc.half-legs.ask: you have varicose veins, cuts or sunburn.
wsvc.half-legs.care: Skip tight clothes for 24 hours and exfoliate gently after 3 days.
wsvc.full-legs.why: Smooth legs for weeks, with finer regrowth after a few sessions.
wsvc.full-legs.step1: We clean the skin and plan the sections.
wsvc.full-legs.step2: Warm wax is applied and removed in strips.
wsvc.full-legs.suits: Anyone who wants smooth legs for a trip or event.
wsvc.full-legs.ask: you have varicose veins, skin infections or sunburn.
wsvc.full-legs.care: Avoid hot baths and gyms for a day; moisturise daily.
wsvc.face-wax.why: A quick way to remove fine facial hair and leave a smooth base.
wsvc.face-wax.step1: We check the skin and choose a gentle face wax.
wsvc.face-wax.step2: A thin layer is applied and removed carefully.
wsvc.face-wax.suits: Light facial hair on the upper lip, chin and sides.
wsvc.face-wax.ask: you use retinoids or have very sensitive or irritated skin.
wsvc.face-wax.care: No scrubbing or heavy makeup for the day.
wsvc.manicure.why: Clean, shaped nails and soft hands make everything look more finished.
wsvc.manicure.step1: We soak the hands and shape the nails.
wsvc.manicure.step2: Cuticles are tidied and dead skin gently removed.
wsvc.manicure.step3: We massage with lotion and finish with polish if you like.
wsvc.manicure.suits: Anyone; a good habit every 2–3 weeks.
wsvc.manicure.ask: you have a cut, infection or nail fungus.
wsvc.manicure.care: Moisturise hands and avoid harsh soaps for a few hours.
wsvc.deluxe-manicure.why: A longer, richer manicure with scrub, mask and massage.
wsvc.deluxe-manicure.step1: We soak, shape and tidy the cuticles.
wsvc.deluxe-manicure.step2: A hand scrub and mask are applied.
wsvc.deluxe-manicure.step3: A relaxing massage and polish finish it.
wsvc.deluxe-manicure.suits: Dry, rough hands that need extra care.
wsvc.deluxe-manicure.ask: you have broken skin or nail infection.
wsvc.deluxe-manicure.care: Use hand cream daily and wear gloves for washing up.
wsvc.pedicure.why: Soft heels and clean nails; good for foot comfort and a tidy look.
wsvc.pedicure.step1: We soak the feet and clean the nails.
wsvc.pedicure.step2: Heels are scrubbed and dead skin removed.
wsvc.pedicure.step3: A foot massage and polish finish it.
wsvc.pedicure.suits: Anyone, especially if you wear sandals.
wsvc.pedicure.ask: you have open sores, a fungal infection or diabetes (ask first).
wsvc.pedicure.care: Moisturise feet at night and wear clean socks.
wsvc.deluxe-pedicure.why: A fuller foot treatment for cracked heels and tired feet.
wsvc.deluxe-pedicure.step2: A foot mask and callus care follow.
wsvc.deluxe-pedicure.step3: A longer massage and polish finish it.
wsvc.deluxe-pedicure.suits: Dry heels, calluses and tired feet.
wsvc.deluxe-pedicure.ask: you have wounds, infection or circulation problems (ask first).
wsvc.deluxe-pedicure.care: Apply foot cream daily and avoid walking barefoot.
wsvc.gel-nail-art.why: Gel polish lasts 2–3 weeks with a glossy finish; art adds personality.
wsvc.gel-nail-art.step1: We prep and shape the nails.
wsvc.gel-nail-art.step2: Base, colour and art are applied and cured under a lamp.
wsvc.gel-nail-art.step3: A top coat seals the shine.
wsvc.gel-nail-art.suits: Anyone who wants long-lasting colour or designs.
wsvc.gel-nail-art.ask: you have thin, peeling nails or a gel allergy.
wsvc.gel-nail-art.care: Do not peel off gel; have it soaked off at the salon.
wsvc.head-massage.why: Relieves tension and headaches and helps you relax.
wsvc.head-massage.step1: We sit you comfortably and warm the oil.
wsvc.head-massage.step2: The scalp, neck and shoulders are massaged in slow strokes.
wsvc.head-massage.step3: We finish with a gentle press at the temples.
wsvc.head-massage.ask: you have a fever or an open scalp wound.
wsvc.head-massage.care: Leave the oil on for an hour or wash with a mild shampoo.
wsvc.foot-massage.why: Eases tired feet and helps you relax after a long day.
wsvc.foot-massage.step1: We clean the feet and warm the oil.
wsvc.foot-massage.step2: The foot, ankle and calf are massaged.
wsvc.foot-massage.step3: We finish with a warm towel.
wsvc.foot-massage.suits: People who stand or walk a lot.
wsvc.foot-massage.ask: you have a fever, swelling or a foot injury.
wsvc.foot-massage.care: Drink water and rest your feet for a while.
wsvc.back-massage.why: Relieves tight back, neck and shoulders from desk work or stress.
wsvc.back-massage.step1: We discuss areas of tension and warm the oil.
wsvc.back-massage.step2: Slow, firm strokes work along the back and shoulders.
wsvc.back-massage.suits: Desk workers, and tight, stiff backs.
wsvc.back-massage.ask: you have a spine injury or a fever.
wsvc.back-massage.care: Drink water and avoid heavy lifting for the rest of the day.
wsvc.full-body-massage.why: A full reset for the body: relaxes muscles and calms the mind.
wsvc.full-body-massage.step1: We talk about pressure and any sore spots.
wsvc.full-body-massage.step2: Back, arms, legs and neck are massaged in turn.
wsvc.full-body-massage.step3: We finish with a short rest.
wsvc.full-body-massage.ask: you are pregnant, ill or have an injury.
wsvc.full-body-massage.care: Rest, drink water and avoid a heavy meal for an hour.
wsvc.body-polishing.why: Removes dead skin and leaves the body smooth, soft and glowing.
wsvc.body-polishing.step2: A scrub, then a nourishing mask are applied.
wsvc.body-polishing.suits: Dry, rough or dull skin on the body.
wsvc.body-polishing.ask: you have sunburn, cuts or eczema flare-ups.
wsvc.body-polishing.care: Moisturise daily and skip scrubs for a week.
wsvc.party-makeup.why: Makeup that lasts through the event and looks good in photos.
wsvc.party-makeup.step1: We prep the skin and match the base to your tone.
wsvc.party-makeup.step2: Eyes, brows, cheeks and lips are done to your look.
wsvc.party-makeup.step3: A setting spray locks it in.
wsvc.party-makeup.ask: you have an active breakout or a known cosmetics allergy.
wsvc.party-makeup.care: Remove makeup before sleeping with a cleanser.
wsvc.bridal-makeup.why: Your wedding look needs to last for hours and look perfect in photos.
wsvc.bridal-makeup.step1: We do a trial or discuss the look, outfit and skin type.
wsvc.bridal-makeup.step2: A long-wear base, eyes, lips and contour are applied.
wsvc.bridal-makeup.step3: Setting and touch-up kit are ready.
wsvc.bridal-makeup.ask: you are allergic to a product or have a skin condition.
wsvc.bridal-makeup.care: Start a skin routine 2–4 weeks before; avoid new products near the date.
wsvc.engagement-makeup.why: A softer look than bridal, fresh and photo-friendly for the day.
wsvc.engagement-makeup.step1: We choose a look that matches your outfit.
wsvc.engagement-makeup.step2: A natural base and soft eyes and lips are done.
wsvc.engagement-makeup.step3: We set it for the whole function.
wsvc.engagement-makeup.ask: you have an active breakout or product allergy.
wsvc.saree-draping.why: A neat drape fits well and stays in place all day.
wsvc.saree-draping.step1: We check the saree, blouse and pleats.
wsvc.saree-draping.step2: Pleats are set, the pallu is arranged and pinned.
wsvc.saree-draping.step3: We adjust the fit so you can move easily.
wsvc.saree-draping.suits: Anyone wearing a saree to an event.
wsvc.saree-draping.ask: you need alterations to the blouse or petticoat.
wsvc.saree-draping.care: Avoid sitting on the pleats; keep a few safety pins handy.
wsvc.party-hairstyle.why: A styled hairdo finishes the look and lasts through the event.
wsvc.party-hairstyle.step1: We check your hair and outfit.
wsvc.party-hairstyle.step2: Hair is prepped and styled: curls, waves or an updo.
wsvc.party-hairstyle.step3: We set it with pins and spray.
wsvc.party-hairstyle.ask: your hair is very short or you have a scalp irritation.
wsvc.party-hairstyle.care: Sleep carefully and avoid washing for a day.
wsvc.feather-cut.name: Feather Cut
wsvc.feather-cut.line: Light, wispy layers with a soft, airy finish.
wsvc.feather-cut.what: Hair is cut in fine, feathered layers that taper at the ends and move easily around the face.
wsvc.feather-cut.good: Medium to long hair that needs lightness and movement.
wsvc.feather-cut.why: Feathering removes bulk without losing length, so hair looks lighter and styles easily.
wsvc.feather-cut.step1: We study your hair thickness and face shape and choose where the layers start.
wsvc.feather-cut.step2: Hair is point-cut in fine sections to make soft, wispy ends.
wsvc.feather-cut.step3: We blow-dry to show the movement and shape.
wsvc.feather-cut.suits: Thick or medium hair; round, oval and square faces.
wsvc.feather-cut.ask: your hair is very thin or fine at the ends.
wsvc.feather-cut.care: Trim every 8 weeks. A light serum keeps the ends smooth.
wsvc.pixie-cut.name: Pixie Cut
wsvc.pixie-cut.line: A short, bold cut that is easy to live with.
wsvc.pixie-cut.what: Hair is cut short at the sides and back and a little longer on top, shaped to your face.
wsvc.pixie-cut.good: A fresh, low-maintenance look for those ready to go short.
wsvc.pixie-cut.why: A pixie shows off your features and takes minutes to style every morning.
wsvc.pixie-cut.step1: We talk about length and check your hairline and face shape.
wsvc.pixie-cut.step2: Sides and nape are cut close; the top is shaped and textured.
wsvc.pixie-cut.step3: We style it with a light product so you can see how to do it at home.
wsvc.pixie-cut.suits: Fine to medium hair; oval, heart and long faces with strong features.
wsvc.pixie-cut.ask: you are not sure about going short, or hair is very curly and dense.
wsvc.pixie-cut.care: Needs a trim every 4–5 weeks to keep its shape.
wsvc.ombre.name: Ombre
wsvc.ombre.line: Dark roots that fade smoothly into lighter ends.
wsvc.ombre.what: Colour is blended from the mid-lengths to the ends so the hair goes from dark to light in a soft gradient.
wsvc.ombre.good: A bold but easy-to-grow-out colour for medium to long hair.
wsvc.ombre.why: Ombre keeps your natural roots, so there is no root line and very little upkeep.
wsvc.ombre.step1: We choose how high the colour starts and the shade for the ends.
wsvc.ombre.step2: Hair is lightened from the ends upward and blended into the roots.
wsvc.ombre.step3: We tone, condition and style it.
wsvc.ombre.suits: Dark and medium hair that is in good condition.
wsvc.ombre.ask: your hair is damaged, very short or already lightened many times.
wsvc.ombre.care: Use a purple shampoo weekly and a mask every week to keep the ends soft.
wsvc.hair-gloss.name: Hair Gloss
wsvc.hair-gloss.line: A shine and tone boost without changing your colour much.
wsvc.hair-gloss.what: A gloss treatment adds shine and refreshes colour, fading brassiness and brightening dull tones.
wsvc.hair-gloss.good: Coloured or natural hair that looks dull or brassy.
wsvc.hair-gloss.why: Gloss gives mirror-like shine and keeps colour looking fresh between appointments.
wsvc.hair-gloss.step1: Hair is washed and lightly towel-dried.
wsvc.hair-gloss.step2: The gloss is applied evenly and left to develop.
wsvc.hair-gloss.suits: Any hair; especially coloured or highlighted hair.
wsvc.hair-gloss.ask: you are allergic to hair colour products or have a scalp wound.
wsvc.hair-gloss.care: Use a colour-safe shampoo; the shine lasts 4–6 weeks.
wsvc.protein-treatment.name: Protein Treatment
wsvc.protein-treatment.what: A protein-rich mask is applied to rebuild the hair strand, reducing breakage and adding strength.
wsvc.protein-treatment.good: Limp, breaking or chemically treated hair.
wsvc.protein-treatment.why: Protein fills gaps in damaged hair so it breaks less and feels firmer.
wsvc.protein-treatment.step1: We check how weak the hair is with a gentle stretch test.
wsvc.protein-treatment.step2: The protein mask is applied and left under gentle heat.
wsvc.protein-treatment.ask: your hair is already stiff and brittle (it may need moisture instead).
wsvc.protein-treatment.care: Follow with a moisture mask next time, so hair does not turn stiff.
wsvc.bond-repair.name: Bond Repair
wsvc.bond-repair.line: Deep repair for heavily coloured or bleached hair.
wsvc.bond-repair.what: A bond-building treatment repairs the inside of the hair so colour, bleach and heat do less damage.
wsvc.bond-repair.good: Bleached, highlighted or very damaged hair.
wsvc.bond-repair.why: Bond repair keeps hair strong enough to be coloured again without breaking.
wsvc.bond-repair.step1: We assess the damage and choose the strength.
wsvc.bond-repair.step2: The treatment is applied in sections and left to work.
wsvc.bond-repair.suits: Hair lightened or coloured many times, or very fragile hair.
wsvc.bond-repair.ask: you have a scalp irritation or an allergy to the ingredients.
wsvc.bond-repair.care: Use a gentle shampoo and a leave-in conditioner; avoid high heat.
wsvc.brow-lamination.name: Brow Lamination
wsvc.brow-lamination.line: Brushed-up, fuller-looking brows that stay in shape.
wsvc.brow-lamination.what: The brow hairs are set in an upward, neat direction so they look fuller and groomed for weeks.
wsvc.brow-lamination.why: Lamination gives a filled-in, brushed-up look without makeup every day.
wsvc.brow-lamination.step1: We shape the brows and apply a softening lotion.
wsvc.brow-lamination.step2: Hairs are brushed into place and set with a neutraliser.
wsvc.brow-lamination.step3: We tint if wanted and add a nourishing oil.
wsvc.brow-lamination.suits: Brows that grow in different directions or look thin.
wsvc.brow-lamination.ask: you have sensitive skin, eye irritation or have used retinoids recently.
wsvc.brow-lamination.care: Keep brows dry for 24 hours; brush them up daily with a little oil.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.name: Chin & Cheek Threading
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.line: Clears fine hair on the chin and cheeks.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.what: Threading removes fine hair from the chin, jaw and cheeks without chemicals or heat.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.good: Fine facial hair on the lower face.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.why: A clean lower face makes the skin look smoother and helps makeup sit evenly.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.step1: We check the skin and growth direction.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.step2: Hairs are removed with a thread in small sections.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.step3: A cooling gel soothes the skin.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.suits: Fine to medium hair; sensitive skin that does not suit wax.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.ask: you have active acne, a rash or a fresh sunburn.
wsvc.chin-cheek-threading.care: No scrubs or strong creams for a day.
wsvc.hydra-facial.name: Hydra Facial
wsvc.hydra-facial.line: Deep cleansing and hydration for fresh, plump skin.
wsvc.hydra-facial.what: A multi-step facial that cleanses pores, exfoliates gently and floods the skin with hydrating serums.
wsvc.hydra-facial.good: Dry, dull or congested skin that needs water.
wsvc.hydra-facial.why: Hydrated skin looks smoother, plumper and takes makeup better.
wsvc.hydra-facial.step2: Pores are cleared and a hydrating serum is infused.
wsvc.hydra-facial.step3: A mask and sunscreen finish the facial.
wsvc.hydra-facial.ask: you have a sunburn, open acne or very reactive skin.
wsvc.hydra-facial.care: Wear sunscreen and drink water; skip strong actives for 48 hours.
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.name: Anti-Acne Facial
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.line: Calms breakouts and clears clogged pores.
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.what: A gentle facial with deep cleansing and a calming mask that targets oil, clogged pores and breakouts.
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.why: Regular deep cleansing helps prevent new breakouts and calms redness.
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.step1: We cleanse and look at your skin and concerns.
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.step2: Steam and gentle extraction clear blocked pores.
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.step3: A calming, oil-control mask and light moisturiser finish.
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.suits: Oily and acne-prone skin, or teenage skin.
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.ask: you have severe, painful or cystic acne, or are on acne medication.
wsvc.anti-acne-facial.care: Do not pick the skin; use a gentle cleanser and oil-free moisturiser.
wsvc.bikini-line.name: Bikini Line Wax
wsvc.bikini-line.what: Hair along the bikini line is removed with a gentle wax made for sensitive skin.
wsvc.bikini-line.good: Anyone who wants a neat line for swimwear or comfort.
wsvc.bikini-line.why: Waxing keeps the area clean and smooth for longer than shaving and without razor bumps.
wsvc.bikini-line.step1: We explain the service and keep you covered.
wsvc.bikini-line.step2: A gentle wax is applied and removed in small strips.
wsvc.bikini-line.step3: We soothe with a calming lotion.
wsvc.bikini-line.suits: Anyone comfortable with the service; hair at least a quarter inch.
wsvc.bikini-line.ask: you are on your period and sore, have a rash or any skin infection.
wsvc.bikini-line.care: Wear loose cotton clothes; no hot baths or gym for 24 hours.
wsvc.rica-wax.name: Rica Wax (Sensitive Skin)
wsvc.rica-wax.line: A gentle wax that is kinder to delicate skin.
wsvc.rica-wax.what: A low-temperature, flexible wax that grips hair and not the skin, so it causes less redness.
wsvc.rica-wax.good: Sensitive or delicate skin, and first-time waxing.
wsvc.rica-wax.why: Rica wax reduces redness and irritation, so sensitive skin can be waxed comfortably.
wsvc.rica-wax.step1: We test the wax temperature on your skin.
wsvc.rica-wax.step2: The wax is applied thinly and removed with strips.
wsvc.rica-wax.step3: We finish with a soothing oil or lotion.
wsvc.rica-wax.suits: Sensitive skin, first-timers, and delicate areas such as the face and underarms.
wsvc.rica-wax.ask: you have a rash, cuts, sunburn or an allergy to the wax.
wsvc.rica-wax.care: Avoid sun and scrubs for a day; moisturise.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.name: Acrylic Nail Extensions
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.line: Longer, stronger nails shaped the way you like.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.what: Acrylic is built over the natural nail or a tip to add length and strength, then shaped and polished.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.good: Short or weak nails, and special occasions.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.why: Extensions give instant length and a flawless shape, and protect weak nails.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.step1: We prep the nails and choose length and shape.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.step2: Acrylic is applied, sculpted and filed.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.step3: Polish or art is added and sealed.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.suits: Short, weak or breaking nails; special events.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.ask: you have a nail infection or an allergy to acrylic.
wsvc.acrylic-extensions.care: Do not pull or pick them; get a refill every 3 weeks and have them removed at the salon.
wsvc.french-tips.name: French Tips
wsvc.french-tips.line: A classic clean nail with white tips.
wsvc.french-tips.what: A natural pink or nude base with crisp white tips, in the classic or a modern style.
wsvc.french-tips.good: A neat, timeless look for work, weddings and everyday.
wsvc.french-tips.why: French tips go with every outfit and make nails look long and clean.
wsvc.french-tips.step1: We shape the nails and apply the base colour.
wsvc.french-tips.step2: White tips are painted with a steady hand.
wsvc.french-tips.step3: A top coat seals the look.
wsvc.french-tips.suits: Anyone; it suits all nail shapes.
wsvc.french-tips.ask: you have a nail infection or thin, peeling nails.
wsvc.french-tips.care: Avoid harsh cleaning products; reapply top coat if needed.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.name: Shoulder & Neck Massage
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.line: Releases tight shoulders and a stiff neck.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.what: Focused massage on the neck, shoulders and upper back to ease knots and stiffness.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.good: Desk workers, long-hour drivers and stressed shoulders.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.why: Tension collects in the neck and shoulders and can cause headaches; a massage releases it.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.step1: We find the tight spots and warm the oil.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.step2: Slow, firm strokes and gentle pressure work out the knots.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.step3: We end with soft stretches and a warm towel.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.suits: Stiff neck, tight shoulders and tension headaches.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.ask: you have a neck injury, fever or a recent surgery.
wsvc.shoulder-neck-massage.care: Drink water and keep your neck warm; avoid heavy lifting for the day.
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.name: Aromatherapy Massage
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.line: A calming massage with essential oils.
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.what: A slow, full massage using essential oils such as lavender chosen for relaxation or energy.
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.good: Stress, poor sleep and anyone who wants a deep relax.
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.why: Scent and touch together calm the mind, ease the body and help you sleep better.
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.step1: We choose the oil with you and dim the room.
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.step2: Long, flowing strokes relax the back, arms, legs and neck.
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.step3: We finish with a short rest and water.
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.ask: you are pregnant, allergic to essential oils or have asthma triggered by scents.
wsvc.aromatherapy-massage.care: Rest after the session, drink water and avoid a heavy meal for an hour.
wsvc.hd-makeup.name: HD Makeup
wsvc.hd-makeup.what: Lightweight, high-definition products create a smooth, even base that looks natural on camera and in person.
wsvc.hd-makeup.why: HD makeup stays lightweight and does not look cakey under bright lights or cameras.
wsvc.hd-makeup.step1: We prep the skin and match the base exactly.
wsvc.hd-makeup.step2: A thin, even base, contour, eyes and lips are built layer by layer.
wsvc.hd-makeup.step3: We set it and check in daylight.
wsvc.hd-makeup.ask: you have an active breakout or a cosmetic allergy.
wsvc.hd-makeup.care: Cleanse well at night and moisturise.
wsvc.eye-makeup.name: Eye Makeup
wsvc.eye-makeup.line: Defined, expressive eyes for any outfit.
wsvc.eye-makeup.what: Eyeshadow, liner, lashes and mascara are done to suit your eye shape and outfit.
wsvc.eye-makeup.good: Anyone who wants just their eyes done for a party or festival.
wsvc.eye-makeup.why: Eyes are the focus of the face; the right shape and colour make them stand out.
wsvc.eye-makeup.step1: We look at your eye shape and outfit colour.
wsvc.eye-makeup.step2: Eyeshadow, liner and mascara are blended and set.
wsvc.eye-makeup.step3: We add lashes if you like and check the finish.
wsvc.eye-makeup.suits: All eye shapes; a good option if you already do your own base.
wsvc.eye-makeup.ask: you have eye irritation, an infection or are allergic to lash glue.
wsvc.eye-makeup.care: Remove with an oil-based remover and do not sleep in it.
wdaily.hair.1: Brush gently from the ends upward; never rip through wet hair.
wdaily.hair.2: Use a heat protectant before any hot tool and keep the heat on medium.
wdaily.hair.3: Sleep on a silk or satin pillowcase, or in a loose braid, to reduce frizz.
wdaily.hair-colour.1: Wash with lukewarm or cool water and a colour-safe shampoo.
wdaily.hair-colour.2: Use a leave-in conditioner or mask once a week to keep colour shiny.
wdaily.hair-colour.3: Cover your hair or use a UV protectant in strong sun to stop fading.
wdaily.hair-care.1: Oil the hair lightly once or twice a week and wash after 1–2 hours.
wdaily.hair-care.2: Avoid tight hairstyles and rough towel rubbing; blot dry instead.
wdaily.hair-care.3: Eat enough protein and drink water; hair is built from what you eat.
wdaily.brows.1: Brush the brows up with a clean spoolie every morning.
wdaily.brows.2: Do not pluck between visits; only tidy a few strays.
wdaily.brows.3: Apply a little castor oil or brow serum at night to keep them healthy.
wdaily.facials.1: Cleanse morning and night, and moisturise after both.
wdaily.facials.2: Wear sunscreen of SPF 30 or more every day, even indoors.
wdaily.facials.3: Drink plenty of water and remove makeup before sleeping.
wdaily.waxing.1: Moisturise the area daily to keep the skin soft.
wdaily.waxing.2: After the first 3 days, gently exfoliate 2–3 times a week to prevent ingrown hair.
wdaily.waxing.3: Wear loose cotton clothes for the first day.
wdaily.nails.1: Apply hand or foot cream and cuticle oil every night.
wdaily.nails.2: Wear gloves for washing up and cleaning.
wdaily.nails.3: File in one direction and never use nails as tools.
wdaily.massage.1: Drink a glass of water after every massage.
wdaily.massage.2: Stretch your neck and shoulders for two minutes each morning.
wdaily.massage.3: Take short walking breaks if you sit for hours.
wdaily.makeup.1: Cleanse and moisturise every night, even after a long event.
wdaily.makeup.2: Prep skin with moisturiser and sunscreen before makeup.
wdaily.makeup.3: Replace old products; eye products every 3–6 months.
wsvc.shag-cut.name: Shag Cut
wsvc.shag-cut.line: Choppy, textured layers with an effortless, rock-and-roll feel.
wsvc.shag-cut.what: Many short and long layers are cut through the hair for volume, texture and a lived-in look.
wsvc.shag-cut.good: Wavy or thick hair that needs movement and shape.
wsvc.shag-cut.why: The shag adds body and texture, and looks styled even with little effort.
wsvc.shag-cut.step1: We study your hair texture and face shape and plan the layers.
wsvc.shag-cut.step2: Layers are cut and the ends are textured with a razor or point-cutting.
wsvc.shag-cut.step3: We blow-dry and finish with a texturising product.
wsvc.shag-cut.suits: Wavy, curly or thick hair; round, oval and square faces.
wsvc.shag-cut.ask: your hair is very fine or you like a very sleek, blunt finish.
wsvc.shag-cut.care: Use a texturising spray; trim every 8–10 weeks to keep the shape.
wsvc.blunt-cut.name: Blunt Cut
wsvc.blunt-cut.line: One clean, straight line for thick-looking, healthy ends.
wsvc.blunt-cut.what: Hair is cut to a single straight length with no layers, so the ends look thick and sharp.
wsvc.blunt-cut.good: Fine to medium straight hair that wants fullness.
wsvc.blunt-cut.why: A blunt line makes fine hair look denser and shows off shine.
wsvc.blunt-cut.step1: We choose the length and the shape of the line.
wsvc.blunt-cut.step2: Hair is cut in sections in one straight line.
wsvc.blunt-cut.step3: We dry and check the line is even.
wsvc.blunt-cut.suits: Straight, fine or medium hair; oval, heart and long faces.
wsvc.blunt-cut.ask: your hair is very curly or you want a lot of movement.
wsvc.blunt-cut.care: Trim every 6–8 weeks; a smoothing serum keeps ends sleek.
wsvc.colour-melt.name: Colour Melt
wsvc.colour-melt.line: Two or three shades blended into one smooth, seamless flow.
wsvc.colour-melt.what: Colours are painted and melted together from the roots to the ends with no visible lines.
wsvc.colour-melt.good: A modern, multi-tonal look for medium to long hair.
wsvc.colour-melt.why: A melt blends shades softly, so it grows out gracefully and looks rich in photos.
wsvc.colour-melt.step1: We pick two or three shades that suit your skin tone.
wsvc.colour-melt.step2: The colours are painted and blended by hand.
wsvc.colour-melt.step3: We tone, condition and style it.
wsvc.colour-melt.suits: Healthy, medium to long hair; those who want a rich, dimensional colour.
wsvc.colour-melt.ask: your hair is damaged or recently bleached many times.
wsvc.colour-melt.care: Use colour-safe shampoo and a weekly mask; re-tone every 8–12 weeks.
wsvc.grey-blending.name: Grey Blending
wsvc.grey-blending.line: Softens grey with natural-looking tones instead of solid cover.
wsvc.grey-blending.what: Fine highlights and lowlights are woven through the hair to blur the grey and match your natural colour.
wsvc.grey-blending.good: Early or partial grey, and those who want a softer grow-out.
wsvc.grey-blending.why: Blending hides the sharp line of regrowth, so the grey looks intentional and needs fewer touch-ups.
wsvc.grey-blending.step1: We look at how much grey you have and where.
wsvc.grey-blending.step2: Fine highlights and lowlights are applied around the grey.
wsvc.grey-blending.step3: We tone to a natural shade and style.
wsvc.grey-blending.suits: Grey at the temples and parting, or all-over salt-and-pepper hair.
wsvc.grey-blending.ask: you want fully solid dark colour with no grey showing.
wsvc.grey-blending.care: Use a gloss shampoo; refresh every 8–12 weeks.
wsvc.hair-botox.name: Hair Botox
wsvc.hair-botox.line: Fills and repairs damaged hair for a smooth, shiny finish.
wsvc.hair-botox.what: A deep conditioning treatment fills gaps in the hair strand, reducing frizz and breakage without straightening.
wsvc.hair-botox.good: Dry, frizzy, rough or damaged hair that wants softness.
wsvc.hair-botox.why: It restores shine and softness, and hair keeps its natural movement.
wsvc.hair-botox.step1: We wash and check the damage.
wsvc.hair-botox.step2: The botox formula is applied and sealed with heat.
wsvc.hair-botox.suits: Dry, frizzy, over-processed or lifeless hair.
wsvc.hair-botox.ask: you are pregnant or have a very sensitive scalp.
wsvc.hair-botox.care: No washing for 48 hours; use sulphate-free shampoo.
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.name: Hot Oil Treatment
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.line: A warm oil massage that feeds the scalp and softens hair.
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.what: Warm oil is massaged into the scalp and hair, then steamed, to nourish and relax.
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.good: Dry scalp, dull hair and stress.
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.why: Warm oil reaches deeper than cold oil, nourishing roots and reducing dryness.
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.step1: We warm a blend of oils suited to your hair.
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.step2: Oil is massaged in slowly, then the hair is steamed.
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.suits: Dry, brittle or tired hair and scalp.
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.ask: you have an oily scalp with dandruff, or an allergy to any oil.
wsvc.hot-oil-treatment.care: Do not use very hot oil at home; wash well afterwards.
wsvc.eyelash-lift.name: Eyelash Lift
wsvc.eyelash-lift.line: Curled, lifted lashes that look longer without extensions.
wsvc.eyelash-lift.what: Lashes are lifted and curled from the root so they look longer and the eyes look more open.
wsvc.eyelash-lift.good: Straight or short lashes that need a natural lift.
wsvc.eyelash-lift.why: A lift opens the eyes and saves time on curlers and mascara every morning.
wsvc.eyelash-lift.step1: We cleanse the lashes and choose the curl size.
wsvc.eyelash-lift.step2: Lashes are shaped on a silicone pad and treated with a lifting lotion.
wsvc.eyelash-lift.step3: We set the curl and add a tint if you like.
wsvc.eyelash-lift.ask: you have eye irritation, an infection or are allergic to the products.
wsvc.eyelash-lift.care: Keep lashes dry for 24 hours; avoid waterproof mascara and rubbing the eyes.
wsvc.brow-henna.name: Brow Henna
wsvc.brow-henna.line: A natural stain that fills brows and tints the skin beneath.
wsvc.brow-henna.what: Henna is applied to the brows and the skin below to give a fuller, darker look that lasts longer than tint.
wsvc.brow-henna.good: Sparse brows or gaps that you want to fill naturally.
wsvc.brow-henna.why: Henna stains both hair and skin, so brows look filled for weeks without makeup.
wsvc.brow-henna.step1: We design the shape and mark it.
wsvc.brow-henna.step2: The henna is applied and left to develop.
wsvc.brow-henna.step3: It is removed and the brows are tidied.
wsvc.brow-henna.suits: Sparse, patchy or very light brows.
wsvc.brow-henna.ask: you are allergic to henna or have broken skin on the brows.
wsvc.brow-henna.care: Keep brows dry for 24 hours and avoid scrubs; use a little oil to make it last.
wsvc.vitamin-c-facial.name: Vitamin C Facial
wsvc.vitamin-c-facial.line: Brightens dull skin and fades dark spots.
wsvc.vitamin-c-facial.what: A facial with vitamin C serum and mask to brighten, even out tone and protect against dullness.
wsvc.vitamin-c-facial.good: Dull, uneven skin and early pigmentation.
wsvc.vitamin-c-facial.why: Vitamin C is an antioxidant that brightens skin and helps fade marks over time.
wsvc.vitamin-c-facial.step2: Vitamin C serum is massaged in with a brightening mask.
wsvc.vitamin-c-facial.suits: Dull, tired skin, uneven tone and light marks.
wsvc.vitamin-c-facial.ask: you have a sunburn, very sensitive skin or open acne.
wsvc.vitamin-c-facial.care: Wear sunscreen daily or the brightening effect will fade.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.name: Oxygen Facial
wsvc.oxygen-facial.line: A fresh, plumping facial that revives tired skin.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.what: Pressurised oxygen and serums are infused into the skin to hydrate, plump and give an instant glow.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.good: Tired, dull or dehydrated skin before an event.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.why: It leaves skin looking rested and plump with no downtime, ideal before a function.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.step1: We cleanse and prep the skin.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.step2: Oxygen and a hydrating serum are infused.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.step3: A calming mask and sunscreen finish.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.suits: Tired, dull or dehydrated skin; mature and sensitive skin.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.ask: you have a sunburn, active infection or open skin.
wsvc.oxygen-facial.care: Drink water and wear sunscreen; avoid strong actives for 48 hours.
wsvc.half-arms.name: Half Arms Wax
wsvc.half-arms.line: Smooth forearms in a quick session.
wsvc.half-arms.what: Hair on the forearms, from the elbow to the wrist, is removed with warm wax.
wsvc.half-arms.good: Anyone who wants neat forearms without a full-arm session.
wsvc.half-arms.why: Waxing lasts longer than shaving and regrowth is softer.
wsvc.half-arms.step1: We clean the skin and test the wax.
wsvc.half-arms.step2: Wax is applied below the elbow and removed in small strips.
wsvc.half-arms.suits: Hair at least a quarter inch long.
wsvc.half-arms.ask: you have a rash, cuts or sunburn.
wsvc.half-arms.care: Moisturise and avoid sun for a day.
wsvc.chocolate-wax.name: Chocolate Wax
wsvc.chocolate-wax.line: A creamy, gentle wax for sensitive skin.
wsvc.chocolate-wax.what: A soft, chocolate-based wax that grips hair gently and is kinder to the skin than hard resin wax.
wsvc.chocolate-wax.good: Sensitive skin, and areas such as arms, legs and underarms.
wsvc.chocolate-wax.why: The creamy wax moisturises as it removes hair, so skin stays softer and less red.
wsvc.chocolate-wax.step1: We test the wax temperature on your skin.
wsvc.chocolate-wax.step2: The wax is spread thinly and removed with strips.
wsvc.chocolate-wax.suits: Dry or sensitive skin and first-time waxing.
wsvc.chocolate-wax.ask: you are allergic to chocolate or cocoa products, or have a rash.
wsvc.chocolate-wax.care: Moisturise; no hot baths or gyms for 24 hours.
wsvc.gel-polish.name: Gel Polish
wsvc.gel-polish.line: Chip-free colour that lasts up to three weeks.
wsvc.gel-polish.what: A gel colour is painted on a prepared nail and cured under a lamp for a glossy, long-lasting finish.
wsvc.gel-polish.good: Anyone who wants long-lasting nail colour.
wsvc.gel-polish.why: Gel polish stays glossy and does not chip, which saves time on touch-ups.
wsvc.gel-polish.step1: We shape the nails and tidy the cuticles.
wsvc.gel-polish.step2: Base, colour and top coat are applied and cured.
wsvc.gel-polish.suits: Anyone with healthy nails; busy people.
wsvc.gel-polish.ask: your nails are thin, peeling or you have a gel allergy.
wsvc.gel-polish.care: Do not peel it off; have it soaked off at the salon.
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.name: Paraffin Treatment
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.line: A warm wax dip that softens dry hands and feet.
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.what: Hands or feet are dipped in warm paraffin wax that locks in moisture and soothes stiff joints.
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.good: Dry, rough or cracked hands and feet, and stiff joints.
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.why: Warm paraffin deeply moisturises the skin and leaves it very soft for days.
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.step1: We clean and lightly scrub the skin.
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.step2: Hands or feet are dipped in warm wax and wrapped.
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.step3: The wax is peeled off and we massage in cream.
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.suits: Dry, rough skin; stiff or achy joints.
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.ask: you have open cuts, a skin infection or reduced feeling (ask first).
wsvc.paraffin-treatment.care: Moisturise daily and wear cotton socks or gloves overnight.
wsvc.hand-massage.name: Hand & Arm Massage
wsvc.hand-massage.what: Hands, wrists and forearms are massaged to ease stiffness from typing, writing or housework.
wsvc.hand-massage.good: Desk workers, tailors, and anyone who uses their hands all day.
wsvc.hand-massage.why: Hands carry a lot of strain; a massage improves comfort and flexibility.
wsvc.hand-massage.step1: We warm the oil and the hands.
wsvc.hand-massage.step2: Fingers, palms, wrists and forearms are massaged.
wsvc.hand-massage.suits: Stiff hands, wrist strain and tired fingers.
wsvc.hand-massage.ask: you have a wrist injury, swelling or a skin infection.
wsvc.hand-massage.care: Stretch your fingers and wrists during long tasks.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.name: Deep Tissue Massage
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.line: Firm pressure for deep knots and chronic tension.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.what: Slow, firm strokes reach deeper muscle layers to release knots, tight bands and long-held tension.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.good: Chronic back, neck or shoulder pain, and athletes.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.why: Deep pressure releases tension that a light massage cannot reach, helping posture and movement.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.step1: We discuss pain points and the pressure you want.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.step2: Firm, slow strokes work the tight muscles.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.step3: We stretch gently and finish with a warm towel.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.suits: Chronic aches, tight muscles and posture problems.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.ask: you have a bleeding disorder, blood clots, are pregnant or on blood thinners.
wsvc.deep-tissue-massage.care: Drink plenty of water and rest; mild soreness for a day is normal.
wsvc.reception-makeup.name: Reception Makeup
wsvc.reception-makeup.line: A glamorous, evening-ready look for the reception.
wsvc.reception-makeup.what: A richer, more dramatic look with a long-wear base, defined eyes and bold lips, planned for evening lights and photos.
wsvc.reception-makeup.good: Wedding receptions, sangeet and evening functions.
wsvc.reception-makeup.why: Evening lights and cameras need stronger definition so your face still looks lifted and bright.
wsvc.reception-makeup.step1: We discuss your outfit and jewellery and prep the skin.
wsvc.reception-makeup.step2: Base, contour, eyes, lashes and lips are built for the evening.
wsvc.reception-makeup.step3: We set it and add a touch-up kit.
wsvc.reception-makeup.ask: you have an active breakout or a known cosmetics allergy.
wsvc.reception-makeup.care: Cleanse well at night and moisturise.
wsvc.natural-makeup.name: Natural Everyday Makeup
wsvc.natural-makeup.line: A fresh, barely-there look for daily wear.
wsvc.natural-makeup.what: A light base, soft brows, a touch of blush and tinted lips make skin look healthy and awake.
wsvc.natural-makeup.good: Work, college, daytime events and anyone new to makeup.
wsvc.natural-makeup.why: A natural look evens out skin and brightens the face without looking like makeup.
wsvc.natural-makeup.step1: We prep the skin with moisturiser and sunscreen.
wsvc.natural-makeup.step2: A light base, blush, brows and lip tint are applied.
wsvc.natural-makeup.step3: We set lightly and show you the steps.
wsvc.natural-makeup.suits: Everyday wear, beginners and light-skin-tone finishes.
wsvc.natural-makeup.ask: you have an active breakout or a cosmetics allergy.
wsvc.natural-makeup.care: Cleanse at night and use a light moisturiser.
wsvc.tong-curls.name: Tong Curls
wsvc.tong-curls.line: Bouncy curls or soft waves, set in minutes.
wsvc.tong-curls.what: Hair is curled with a heated tong into tight curls, loose waves or Hollywood waves.
wsvc.tong-curls.good: Straight or slightly wavy hair for a party or photos.
wsvc.tong-curls.why: Curls add instant volume and glamour without a full hairdo.
wsvc.tong-curls.step1: We wash and dry the hair or work on dry hair.
wsvc.tong-curls.step2: A heat protectant goes on and hair is curled in sections.
wsvc.tong-curls.step3: We set the curls with light spray.
wsvc.tong-curls.suits: Medium to long hair; all face shapes.
wsvc.tong-curls.ask: your hair is very damaged or you have a scalp irritation.
wsvc.tong-curls.care: Do not brush curls; sleep with hair tied loosely on top.
wsvc.braid-styling.name: Braid Styling
wsvc.braid-styling.line: Neat braids for work, play or a function.
wsvc.braid-styling.what: Hair is braided in a style you choose: classic, fishtail, side braid, crown or boho.
wsvc.braid-styling.good: Medium to long hair, school, festivals and parties.
wsvc.braid-styling.why: A braid keeps hair tidy for hours and looks styled with little effort.
wsvc.braid-styling.step1: We brush the hair and choose the braid with you.
wsvc.braid-styling.step2: Hair is sectioned and braided evenly.
wsvc.braid-styling.step3: We pin and finish with spray and accessories if you like.
wsvc.braid-styling.suits: Medium to long hair; all face shapes.
wsvc.braid-styling.ask: your hair is very short or you have a sore scalp.
wsvc.braid-styling.care: Sleep in the braid with a silk scarf; take it out gently.
wsvc.bun-styling.name: Bun & Ponytail Styling
wsvc.bun-styling.line: A sleek or messy bun or high ponytail.
wsvc.bun-styling.what: Hair is shaped into a clean bun, messy bun, top knot or sleek high ponytail.
wsvc.bun-styling.good: Medium to long hair, for work, dance and functions.
wsvc.bun-styling.why: A bun or ponytail keeps hair off the face and the neck cool, and looks polished.
wsvc.bun-styling.step1: We brush and prep the hair with a little product.
wsvc.bun-styling.step2: Hair is gathered and shaped into your chosen style.
wsvc.bun-styling.step3: We pin it and set with spray.
wsvc.bun-styling.suits: Medium to long hair; all face shapes.
wsvc.bun-styling.ask: your hair is short, or you have a headache from tight styles.
wsvc.bun-styling.care: Avoid very tight styles every day to protect the hairline.
wsvc.wash-and-style.name: Wash & Style
wsvc.wash-and-style.line: A quick shampoo, condition and a styled finish.
wsvc.wash-and-style.what: A shampoo and conditioner with a scalp massage, followed by a quick style: straight, wavy or smooth.
wsvc.wash-and-style.good: Anyone who wants fresh hair fast before work or an event.
wsvc.wash-and-style.why: Freshly washed and styled hair looks cleaner and fuller than home styling.
wsvc.wash-and-style.step1: We wash and condition with a short scalp massage.
wsvc.wash-and-style.step2: Hair is towel-dried and prepped with a protectant.
wsvc.wash-and-style.step3: We style it to a finish you like.
wsvc.wash-and-style.suits: All hair types; all face shapes.
wsvc.wash-and-style.ask: you have an open scalp wound or a rash.
wsvc.wash-and-style.care: Avoid washing again for a day if the style should last.
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.name: Henna Hair Colour
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.line: A natural, conditioning colour with warm red-brown tones.
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.what: Henna paste is applied to the hair to cover grey and give a rich, natural reddish-brown shine.
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.good: Those who want a chemical-free colour and grey cover.
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.why: Henna conditions as it colours, leaving hair strong and glossy.
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.step1: We do a patch test and mix the henna.
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.step2: The paste is applied to the whole head and left to develop.
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.suits: Grey cover and a warm, natural tone.
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.ask: you want a cool, ash or very dark black shade, or are allergic to henna.
wsvc.henna-hair-colour.care: Avoid washing for 24 hours; it deepens over 48 hours.
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.name: Semi-Permanent Colour
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.line: A gentle colour that fades out over weeks.
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.what: A low-commitment, ammonia-free colour that tints hair and fades gradually without a harsh root line.
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.good: First-time colour, and those who like to change shades.
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.why: It is gentler on hair, so you can try a shade without a long commitment.
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.step1: We pick a shade and do a strand test.
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.step2: Colour is applied evenly and left to develop.
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.suits: First-time colour or a trial of a new shade.
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.ask: you need full grey cover, or are allergic to colour products.
wsvc.semi-permanent-colour.care: Use colour-safe shampoo; it fades in 4–6 weeks.
wsvc.toner-refresh.name: Toner Refresh
wsvc.toner-refresh.line: Cancels brassiness and revives faded colour.
wsvc.toner-refresh.what: A toner is applied to neutralise yellow or orange tones and refresh the shade between full colours.
wsvc.toner-refresh.good: Blonde, highlighted or lightened hair that has turned brassy.
wsvc.toner-refresh.why: A toner keeps blonde and highlights looking clean and expensive between appointments.
wsvc.toner-refresh.step1: We look at the tone of your hair and pick the toner.
wsvc.toner-refresh.step2: The toner is applied and watched closely.
wsvc.toner-refresh.suits: Blonde, ash, highlighted or balayage hair.
