wsvc.toner-refresh.ask: your hair is very damaged or you have a scalp irritation.
wsvc.toner-refresh.care: Use a purple shampoo once a week; avoid hot water.
wsvc.brazilian-blowout.name: Brazilian Blowout
wsvc.brazilian-blowout.line: Smooth, frizz-free hair that keeps its body.
wsvc.brazilian-blowout.what: A smoothing treatment seals the hair with a protein formula to cut frizz and shorten blow-dry time while keeping some wave.
wsvc.brazilian-blowout.good: Frizzy, thick or unruly hair that needs smoothing.
wsvc.brazilian-blowout.why: It tames frizz and saves styling time, and keeps natural movement.
wsvc.brazilian-blowout.step1: We wash and check your hair.
wsvc.brazilian-blowout.step2: The formula is applied section by section and sealed with a flat iron.
wsvc.brazilian-blowout.ask: you are pregnant, or have a scalp irritation or very damaged hair.
wsvc.brazilian-blowout.care: No washing or tying for 3 days; use sulphate-free shampoo.
wsvc.brow-shaping.name: Brow Shaping
wsvc.brow-shaping.line: A complete shape designed for your face.
wsvc.brow-shaping.what: Brows are mapped to your face, then shaped with threading or tweezers and trimmed for a clean finish.
wsvc.brow-shaping.good: Anyone starting fresh or wanting a new shape.
wsvc.brow-shaping.why: The right shape lifts the eyes and balances the face.
wsvc.brow-shaping.step1: We map the start, arch and end of each brow.
wsvc.brow-shaping.step2: Excess hair is removed and long hairs trimmed.
wsvc.brow-shaping.step3: We soothe the skin and brush the brows into place.
wsvc.brow-shaping.suits: All brow types; all face shapes.
wsvc.brow-shaping.ask: you use retinoids or have irritated skin on the brows.
wsvc.brow-shaping.care: Do not tweeze the shape between visits; brush up daily.
wsvc.brow-makeover.name: Brow Makeover
wsvc.brow-makeover.line: Shape, tint and tidy in one visit.
wsvc.brow-makeover.what: A full brow session: shaping, tint and finishing, for a complete change in one appointment.
wsvc.brow-makeover.good: Anyone who wants a full brow transformation before an event.
wsvc.brow-makeover.why: Doing shape and colour together gives balanced brows with one visit.
wsvc.brow-makeover.step1: We map the shape and choose the tint shade.
wsvc.brow-makeover.step2: Brows are shaped, tinted and tidied.
wsvc.brow-makeover.step3: We soothe the skin and finish with a brow gel.
wsvc.brow-makeover.ask: you are allergic to tint or have irritated skin.
wsvc.brow-makeover.care: Keep brows dry for 24 hours; tint lasts 3–4 weeks.
wsvc.express-cleanup.name: Express Clean-Up
wsvc.express-cleanup.line: A quick cleanse for fresher skin.
wsvc.express-cleanup.what: Cleansing, a light scrub, steam and a mask in a short session to clear surface dirt and oil.
wsvc.express-cleanup.good: A busy day, or skin that needs a fast refresh.
wsvc.express-cleanup.why: A regular clean-up keeps pores clear and skin fresh between facials.
wsvc.express-cleanup.step2: A light scrub and steam open the pores.
wsvc.express-cleanup.step3: A mask and moisturiser finish it.
wsvc.express-cleanup.suits: All skin types; a good first step for beginners.
wsvc.express-cleanup.ask: you have active acne, a rash or a sunburn.
wsvc.express-cleanup.care: Wear sunscreen and avoid heavy makeup for a few hours.
wsvc.deep-cleanup.name: Deep Clean-Up
wsvc.deep-cleanup.line: A thorough cleanse that clears blackheads and congestion.
wsvc.deep-cleanup.what: Cleansing, scrub, steam, gentle extraction and a mask to clear blocked pores.
wsvc.deep-cleanup.good: Oily or congested skin with blackheads.
wsvc.deep-cleanup.why: Clearing blocked pores helps prevent breakouts and keeps skin smooth.
wsvc.deep-cleanup.step1: We cleanse and steam the skin.
wsvc.deep-cleanup.step2: Blackheads and whiteheads are gently extracted.
wsvc.deep-cleanup.step3: A calming mask and moisturiser finish.
wsvc.deep-cleanup.ask: you have severe acne, a rash or very sensitive skin.
wsvc.deep-cleanup.care: Do not pick the skin; use a gentle cleanser.
wsvc.oil-control-facial.name: Oil-Control Facial
wsvc.oil-control-facial.line: Matte, balanced skin for oily complexions.
wsvc.oil-control-facial.what: A facial with a deep cleanse, clay mask and oil-balancing serum to control shine and tighten pores.
wsvc.oil-control-facial.why: Balanced oil means less shine, fewer breakouts and makeup that lasts.
wsvc.oil-control-facial.step1: We cleanse and steam the skin.
wsvc.oil-control-facial.step2: A clay mask and oil-balancing serum are applied.
wsvc.oil-control-facial.step3: A light moisturiser and sunscreen finish.
wsvc.oil-control-facial.ask: you have dry or very sensitive skin, or active infections.
wsvc.oil-control-facial.care: Use an oil-free moisturiser and blotting paper through the day.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.name: Pigmentation Facial
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.line: Targets dark patches and uneven tone.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.what: A facial with brightening and gentle peeling ingredients that help fade dark spots and even out tone.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.good: Dark spots, melasma and uneven skin tone.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.why: Regular, gentle treatment fades patches gradually while sun care stops them returning.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.step1: We examine your skin and pigment patches.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.step2: A gentle peel and brightening serum are applied.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.step3: A soothing mask and sunscreen finish.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.suits: Sun spots, melasma, acne marks and uneven tone.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.ask: you are pregnant (melasma needs a doctor), have a sunburn or open skin.
wsvc.pigmentation-facial.care: Sunscreen every day is a must; results need a few sessions.
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.name: Sensitive Skin Facial
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.line: A gentle, fragrance-free facial for reactive skin.
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.what: A calming facial with soothing, fragrance-free products to cleanse and hydrate without irritation.
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.good: Reactive, red or easily irritated skin.
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.why: Gentle care strengthens the skin barrier and reduces redness and stinging.
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.step1: We patch test and cleanse very gently.
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.step2: A soothing serum and cooling mask are applied with light pressure.
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.step3: A barrier cream and sunscreen finish.
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.suits: Sensitive, red or reactive skin, rosacea-prone skin.
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.ask: you have an active infection or a severe reaction (see a doctor).
wsvc.sensitive-skin-facial.care: Use fragrance-free products; avoid hot water and scrubs.
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.name: Under-Eye Treatment
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.what: A targeted treatment with cooling gel, massage and a brightening eye mask for tired eyes.
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.good: Dark circles, puffiness and tired-looking eyes.
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.why: The skin around the eyes is thin and shows tiredness first; targeted care refreshes it.
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.step1: We cleanse the eye area gently.
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.step2: A cooling massage and a brightening serum are applied.
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.step3: An eye mask is set and we finish with eye cream.
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.suits: Dark circles, puffy or tired eyes.
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.ask: you have an eye infection or irritation.
wsvc.under-eye-treatment.care: Sleep well, drink water and use an eye cream at night.
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.name: Arms & Legs Combo Wax
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.line: Full arms and full legs in one session.
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.what: Both arms and both legs are waxed together at a combined price and a shorter total time.
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.good: Anyone preparing for a trip, an event or summer.
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.why: Doing both together saves time and keeps regrowth even.
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.step1: We clean the skin and test the wax.
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.step2: Arms, then legs, are waxed in sections.
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.suits: Hair at least a quarter inch long.
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.ask: you have varicose veins, cuts, a rash or sunburn.
wsvc.arms-legs-combo.care: Moisturise daily; no hot baths or gym for 24 hours.
wsvc.full-back-wax.name: Full Back Wax
wsvc.full-back-wax.what: Hair on the upper and lower back is removed with warm wax for a smooth finish.
wsvc.full-back-wax.why: A smooth back is hard to shave and looks cleaner for longer when waxed.
wsvc.full-back-wax.step1: We prepare the skin and test the wax.
wsvc.full-back-wax.step2: Wax is applied in sections across the back and removed.
wsvc.full-back-wax.ask: you have a rash, acne on the back, or sunburn.
wsvc.full-back-wax.care: Avoid tight clothes and sweat for 24 hours; exfoliate after 3 days.
wsvc.brazilian-wax.name: Brazilian Wax
wsvc.brazilian-wax.what: Hair in the bikini area is removed fully with a gentle, hypoallergenic wax by a trained therapist, with privacy.
wsvc.brazilian-wax.good: Anyone who wants a smooth, hygienic result for swimwear or comfort.
wsvc.brazilian-wax.why: Waxing lasts longer than shaving and hair grows back finer.
wsvc.brazilian-wax.step1: We explain the service, keep you covered and prepare the skin.
wsvc.brazilian-wax.step2: A gentle wax is applied and removed in small strips.
wsvc.brazilian-wax.step3: We soothe with a calming lotion.
wsvc.brazilian-wax.suits: Anyone comfortable with the service; hair at least a quarter inch.
wsvc.brazilian-wax.ask: you have a rash, infection, are on your period or have very sensitive skin.
wsvc.brazilian-wax.care: Wear loose cotton; no hot baths, gym or swimming for 24–48 hours.
wsvc.hands-underarms-combo.name: Arms & Underarms Combo
wsvc.hands-underarms-combo.line: Smooth arms and underarms in one go.
wsvc.hands-underarms-combo.what: Full arms and underarms are waxed together for a smooth, sleeveless-ready look.
wsvc.hands-underarms-combo.why: The combo saves time and leaves the whole upper body neat.
wsvc.hands-underarms-combo.step1: We clean the skin and test the wax.
wsvc.hands-underarms-combo.step2: Arms then underarms are waxed in sections.
wsvc.hands-underarms-combo.suits: Hair at least a quarter inch long.
wsvc.hands-underarms-combo.ask: you have a rash, cuts, sunburn or recent deodorant irritation.
wsvc.hands-underarms-combo.care: No deodorant or hot showers for 24 hours; wear loose cotton.
wsvc.glitter-nails.name: Glitter Nails
wsvc.glitter-nails.line: Sparkling nails for festivals and parties.
wsvc.glitter-nails.what: Gel or regular polish with glitter, foil or sparkle accents, applied neatly and sealed with a top coat.
wsvc.glitter-nails.good: Festivals, parties and anyone who loves sparkle.
wsvc.glitter-nails.why: Glitter nails complete a festive outfit and last well with gel.
wsvc.glitter-nails.step1: We shape the nails and apply the base.
wsvc.glitter-nails.step2: Glitter or foil is applied by hand.
wsvc.glitter-nails.step3: A top coat seals the sparkle.
wsvc.glitter-nails.suits: Any nail length; best on healthy nails.
wsvc.glitter-nails.ask: you have thin, peeling nails or a glitter or gel allergy.
wsvc.glitter-nails.care: Do not peel off; have gel soaked off at the salon.
wsvc.chrome-nails.name: Chrome Nails
wsvc.chrome-nails.what: A chrome or pearl powder is buffed over gel polish to make nails shine like a mirror.
wsvc.chrome-nails.good: A modern, high-shine look for parties and photos.
wsvc.chrome-nails.why: Chrome gives an eye-catching, glass-like shine that photographs beautifully.
wsvc.chrome-nails.step1: We shape the nails and apply a gel base.
wsvc.chrome-nails.step2: Chrome powder is buffed on and cured.
wsvc.chrome-nails.step3: A top coat seals the finish.
wsvc.chrome-nails.ask: you have thin or peeling nails or a gel allergy.
wsvc.chrome-nails.care: Avoid harsh cleaners; do not peel the gel.
wsvc.ombre-nails.name: Ombre Nails
wsvc.ombre-nails.line: A soft blend of two colours on each nail.
wsvc.ombre-nails.what: Two or more shades are blended with a sponge or brush so each nail fades from one colour to another.
wsvc.ombre-nails.good: Anyone who wants a soft, trendy colour effect.
wsvc.ombre-nails.why: Ombre looks elegant on any outfit and grows out gracefully.
wsvc.ombre-nails.step1: We shape the nails and choose two shades.
wsvc.ombre-nails.step2: Colours are sponged and blended, then cured.
wsvc.ombre-nails.step3: A top coat seals the finish.
wsvc.ombre-nails.suits: Any nail length; pastel or bold shades.
wsvc.ombre-nails.ask: you have thin nails or a gel allergy.
wsvc.ombre-nails.care: Re-seal with top coat if it dulls; have gel removed at the salon.
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.name: Bridal Nail Art
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.line: Detailed nail art to match the bridal look.
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.what: A custom design with gel, fine art, stones or gold detailing to match the outfit and jewellery.
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.why: Hands are in every wedding photo; matching nail art completes the look.
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.step1: We discuss the outfit and choose a design.
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.step2: Base, fine art and stones are applied and cured.
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.step3: A top coat seals the design.
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.suits: Brides and wedding guests; healthy nails.
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.ask: you have a nail infection or a gel allergy.
wsvc.bridal-nail-art.care: Book a few days before the wedding; keep hands moisturised.
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.name: Hot Stone Massage
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.line: Warm stones melt away deep tension.
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.what: Smooth, heated stones are placed and glided over the body with oil to relax muscles and calm the mind.
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.why: Gentle heat warms muscles so they release without needing deep pressure.
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.step1: We warm the stones and oil.
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.step2: Stones are placed on the back and glided with slow strokes.
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.step3: We finish with a short rest.
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.suits: Stiff, tense muscles, stress and poor sleep.
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.ask: you are pregnant, have heat sensitivity, diabetes or poor circulation (ask first).
wsvc.hot-stone-massage.care: Drink water and rest; avoid a heavy meal for an hour.
wsvc.office-makeup.name: Office Makeup
wsvc.office-makeup.line: A polished, professional look for work.
wsvc.office-makeup.what: A neat base, defined brows, soft eyes and a natural lip that stay fresh through a working day.
wsvc.office-makeup.why: A polished face builds confidence and stays comfortable all day.
wsvc.office-makeup.step1: We prep the skin with moisturiser and sunscreen.
wsvc.office-makeup.step2: A light base, brows, soft eyes and lip colour are applied.
wsvc.office-makeup.step3: We set it for a long day and show you the steps.
wsvc.office-makeup.ask: you have an active breakout or a cosmetics allergy.
wsvc.office-makeup.care: Carry a blotting paper and lip colour for touch-ups.
wsvc.college-makeup.name: College Makeup
wsvc.college-makeup.line: A quick, fresh look for college and outings.
wsvc.college-makeup.what: A light base, a touch of blush, mascara and lip tint for a fresh, youthful look in minutes.
wsvc.college-makeup.good: Students and anyone short on time.
wsvc.college-makeup.why: A light, quick look suits young skin and daily wear.
wsvc.college-makeup.step1: We prep with moisturiser and sunscreen.
wsvc.college-makeup.step2: A light tint, blush, mascara and lip tint are applied.
wsvc.college-makeup.step3: We show you the quick routine.
wsvc.college-makeup.ask: you have an active breakout or a cosmetics allergy.
wsvc.college-makeup.care: Wash your face well at night; keep a lip tint for touch-ups.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.name: Makeup Touch-Up
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.line: A fast refresh for makeup you already have on.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.what: Existing makeup is refreshed: base blotted and re-set, eyes and lips renewed, ready for the next part of the event.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.good: Mid-event refreshes, and touch-ups after photos.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.why: Makeup shifts after hours; a quick fix brings back the freshness for the evening.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.step1: We blot and re-prep the skin.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.step2: Base, eyes and lips are touched up where needed.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.step3: We set it again for the rest of the event.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.suits: Anyone already wearing makeup from the day.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.ask: you have eye irritation or an active breakout.
wsvc.makeup-touch-up.care: Keep blotting paper and your lip colour handy.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.name: Lip Colour Styling
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.line: The right lip shade, shaped and set.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.what: Lips are exfoliated, shaped with liner and filled with a shade that suits your skin tone and outfit.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.good: A quick glam touch, or someone unsure about shades.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.why: A well-chosen lip colour lifts the whole face in minutes.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.step1: We prep the lips and choose a shade.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.step2: Lips are lined and coloured, then blotted.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.step3: We set the colour so it lasts.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.suits: Anyone who wants a quick lip colour consultation.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.ask: you have a cold sore, an allergy to lip products or lip irritation.
wsvc.lip-colour-styling.care: Carry the shade for touch-ups; use lip balm at night.
wsvc.v-cut.name: V-Cut
wsvc.v-cut.line: Layers that taper to a point at the centre back.
wsvc.v-cut.what: The back is cut in a V so the longest hair sits at the middle and shorter pieces fall on either side. Unlike a U-cut, the point is sharp and the layers are more dramatic.
wsvc.v-cut.good: Long, thick or straight hair that needs shape and lift.
wsvc.v-cut.why: The V-shape slims the back and gives a clear, intentional layered line when hair is worn loose.
wsvc.v-cut.step1: We mark the centre point and how steep the V should be.
wsvc.v-cut.step2: Hair is cut from both sides towards the centre, then blended.
wsvc.v-cut.step3: We dry the hair so you can see the V from the back.
wsvc.v-cut.suits: Long, thick or straight hair; oval, round and square faces.
wsvc.v-cut.ask: your hair is very thin, or you want a rounded, soft back.
wsvc.v-cut.care: Trim every 8–10 weeks to keep the point neat.
wsvc.u-cut.name: U-Cut
wsvc.u-cut.line: A soft, rounded curve across the back.
wsvc.u-cut.what: The ends are cut in a smooth U-shaped curve, so the back looks rounded and the length stays more even than in a V-cut.
wsvc.u-cut.good: Fine or medium hair that wants a soft, neat finish without losing length.
wsvc.u-cut.why: The U-shape keeps the ends looking fuller and is gentler on thin hair than a pointed V.
wsvc.u-cut.step1: We decide how deep the curve should be.
wsvc.u-cut.step2: Hair is cut in a smooth arc from side to side.
wsvc.u-cut.step3: We soften the line and dry to check the curve.
wsvc.u-cut.suits: Fine to medium, straight or wavy hair; most face shapes.
wsvc.u-cut.ask: you want strong, visible layers or a pointed shape.
wsvc.u-cut.care: Trim every 8–10 weeks; the curve stays smooth.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.name: Butterfly Cut
wsvc.butterfly-cut.line: Short face-framing layers over long lengths.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.what: Short, bouncy layers around the face and crown sit over long layers underneath, giving a two-tier shape. It is not the same as a plain layered cut: the top layers are much shorter and deliberately visible.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.good: Long hair that needs volume at the top and movement around the face.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.why: The two tiers create fullness and a soft blow-dried look that frames the face.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.step1: We choose how short the top layers should be, at the cheekbone or chin.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.step2: The top layers are cut short and the lengths are kept long and blended.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.step3: We blow-dry with a round brush to show the lift.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.suits: Long, straight or wavy hair; oval, long and heart faces.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.ask: your hair is very thin, or you want a single blunt length.
wsvc.butterfly-cut.care: Blow-dry the face layers outwards to keep the shape; trim every 8–10 weeks.
wsvc.money-piece.name: Money Piece
wsvc.money-piece.line: Bright face-framing strands only at the front.
wsvc.money-piece.what: Two chunky, bright strands at the front are lightened to frame the face. Unlike highlights, the rest of the hair is left untouched.
wsvc.money-piece.good: Dark or medium hair that wants a bold brightening without a full colour.
wsvc.money-piece.why: It brightens the complexion and draws attention to the face with very little hair coloured.
wsvc.money-piece.step1: We pick the shade and the thickness of the front sections.
wsvc.money-piece.step2: The front strands are lightened with foil.
wsvc.money-piece.step3: We tone and style them to show off the contrast.
wsvc.money-piece.suits: Dark to medium hair; those who want a low-commitment colour.
wsvc.money-piece.ask: your hair is damaged at the front or you want an all-over colour.
wsvc.money-piece.care: Use a purple shampoo weekly; refresh every 8–12 weeks.
wsvc.babylights.name: Babylights
wsvc.babylights.line: Ultra-fine, subtle highlights for a sun-kissed glow.
wsvc.babylights.what: Very thin strands, finer than regular highlights, are lightened through the hair for a soft, natural brightness that looks like childhood sun-lightened hair.
wsvc.babylights.good: Anyone who wants a barely-there lift with no visible streaks.
wsvc.babylights.why: The fine strands blend so well that there are no stripes and no harsh regrowth line.
wsvc.babylights.step1: We choose the shade and the finesse of the strands.
wsvc.babylights.step2: Many fine strands are lightened and foiled.
wsvc.babylights.step3: We tone and style for a soft finish.
wsvc.babylights.suits: Dark to medium hair; natural, subtle looks.
wsvc.babylights.ask: your hair is damaged, or you want bold contrast.
wsvc.babylights.care: Use sulphate-free shampoo; a weekly mask keeps it soft.
wsvc.lowlights.name: Lowlights
wsvc.lowlights.line: Darker strands that add depth to light or flat hair.
wsvc.lowlights.what: Strands darker than your base are added to bring depth and dimension. It is the opposite of highlights: instead of lightening, it deepens.
wsvc.lowlights.good: Over-lightened, flat or very blonde hair that needs depth.
wsvc.lowlights.why: Lowlights break up flatness, make hair look thicker and tone down brassiness.
wsvc.lowlights.step1: We choose a shade a few levels darker than your hair.
wsvc.lowlights.step2: Fine strands are coloured darker with foil.
wsvc.lowlights.ask: your hair is very damaged or you want a lighter look.
wsvc.lowlights.care: Use colour-safe shampoo; refresh every 10–12 weeks.
wsvc.deep-conditioning-mask.name: Deep Conditioning Mask
wsvc.deep-conditioning-mask.line: A rich mask to restore softness, no massage ritual.
wsvc.deep-conditioning-mask.what: A concentrated moisture mask is left on the hair to soften it. Compared with a hair spa, it is quicker and focused on the hair, not the scalp massage and steam.
wsvc.deep-conditioning-mask.good: Dry, rough hair that needs fast softness.
wsvc.deep-conditioning-mask.why: A mask quickly restores moisture and shine between longer treatments.
wsvc.deep-conditioning-mask.step2: The mask is applied and left to soak.
wsvc.deep-conditioning-mask.ask: you have an oily scalp and fine hair that weighs down easily.
wsvc.deep-conditioning-mask.care: Use a mask at home once a week, only on the lengths.
wsvc.scalp-detox.name: Scalp Detox Scrub
wsvc.scalp-detox.line: Clears build-up from the scalp for lighter roots.
wsvc.scalp-detox.what: An exfoliating scrub lifts product build-up, oil and dead skin from the scalp. Unlike a scalp treatment, it is for cleaning and refreshing, not for treating a specific problem.
wsvc.scalp-detox.good: Heavy product users, oily roots and flat hair at the crown.
wsvc.scalp-detox.why: A clean scalp lets roots lift and makes colour and treatments work better.
wsvc.scalp-detox.step1: We part the hair and check the scalp.
wsvc.scalp-detox.step2: The scrub is massaged in gently, section by section.
wsvc.scalp-detox.step3: We rinse, condition the lengths and dry.
wsvc.scalp-detox.ask: your scalp is sore, has open wounds or is very sensitive.
wsvc.scalp-detox.care: Do not over-scrub at home; once every 2–3 weeks is enough.
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.name: Anti-Hairfall Treatment
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.what: A course of serum, scalp massage and a strengthening mask aimed at the roots to reduce hair that falls out and support new growth.
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.good: Thinning, shedding or weak hair at the roots.
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.why: Strong roots hold hair in place; a course shows more than a single session.
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.step1: We look at your scalp and ask about shedding.
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.step2: A strengthening serum is massaged into the roots.
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.step3: A mask is applied and we rinse and dry.
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.suits: Increased shedding, thin parting and weak hair.
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.ask: you have sudden or patchy hair loss (see a doctor first).
wsvc.anti-hairfall-treatment.care: Eat enough iron and protein; avoid tight styles and harsh heat.
wsvc.brow-waxing.name: Brow Waxing
wsvc.brow-waxing.line: A quick, clean brow shape with wax.
wsvc.brow-waxing.what: Stray hairs around the brow are removed with a small amount of wax. It removes many hairs at once and lasts a little longer than threading, but threading gives a finer line.
wsvc.brow-waxing.good: Dense or coarse brow hair, and those who like speed.
wsvc.brow-waxing.why: Wax lifts coarse hair and skin-level fuzz quickly, so the brow area looks tidy for weeks.
wsvc.brow-waxing.step1: We mark the shape and clean the skin.
wsvc.brow-waxing.step2: A thin layer of wax is applied only to stray hairs and removed.
wsvc.brow-waxing.step3: We soothe with gel and tidy any leftovers with a thread.
wsvc.brow-waxing.suits: Thick or coarse brow hair; fast results.
wsvc.brow-waxing.ask: you use retinoids, or have very sensitive, thin skin.
wsvc.brow-waxing.care: Do not touch for a few hours; avoid sun and makeup the same day.
wsvc.lash-tint.name: Lash Tint
wsvc.lash-tint.what: A semi-permanent dye is applied to the lashes so they look darker and fuller. It colours the lashes but does not curl them, unlike a lash lift.
wsvc.lash-tint.why: Tinted lashes frame the eyes all day and save time on mascara.
wsvc.lash-tint.step1: We cleanse the lashes and protect the skin below.
wsvc.lash-tint.step2: The tint is applied and left to develop.
wsvc.lash-tint.step3: We wipe it away and check the depth of colour.
wsvc.lash-tint.suits: Light or fair lashes, swimmers and busy people.
wsvc.lash-tint.ask: you have eye irritation, a patch-test reaction or recent eye infection.
wsvc.lash-tint.care: Avoid oil-based cleansers and rubbing for 24 hours.
wsvc.brow-trim.name: Brow Trim & Tidy
wsvc.brow-trim.line: A quick tidy that keeps your own shape.
wsvc.brow-trim.what: Only the long hairs are trimmed and a few strays are tweezed, with no change to the shape. It is the lightest brow service.
wsvc.brow-trim.good: Between full shaping visits, or if you like your brows as they are.
wsvc.brow-trim.why: A trim keeps brows neat without over-plucking.
wsvc.brow-trim.step1: We brush the brows up and out.
wsvc.brow-trim.step2: Long hairs are trimmed to length.
wsvc.brow-trim.step3: A few strays are removed and brows are set with gel.
wsvc.brow-trim.suits: Natural brows that just need a tidy.
wsvc.brow-trim.ask: you want a new shape (choose Brow Shaping instead).
wsvc.brow-trim.care: Brush daily; do not pluck between visits.
wsvc.collagen-facial.name: Collagen Facial
wsvc.collagen-facial.line: Plumping and firming for tired, softer-looking skin.
wsvc.collagen-facial.what: A collagen-rich mask and massage to hydrate and firm. It focuses on plumpness and bounce, where an anti-ageing facial targets lines and a vitamin C facial targets tone.
wsvc.collagen-facial.good: Dull, slightly loose or dehydrated skin before an event.
wsvc.collagen-facial.why: Collagen products hold moisture and make skin look plumper and smoother for days.
wsvc.collagen-facial.step2: A collagen serum and massage are applied, then a sheet or gel mask.
wsvc.collagen-facial.ask: you are allergic to marine or animal-derived products, or have open skin.
wsvc.collagen-facial.care: Wear sunscreen and drink water; the glow lasts a few days.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.name: Anti-Ageing Facial
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.line: Targets fine lines and loss of firmness.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.what: A facial with peptides, retinol-free anti-ageing serums and a firming massage to soften fine lines. It targets lines and firmness, where a collagen facial targets plumpness.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.good: Fine lines, loss of firmness and mature skin.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.why: Regular firming care slows the look of ageing and keeps skin supple.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.step1: We cleanse and assess lines and firmness.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.step2: A firming serum and a lifting massage are applied.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.step3: A firming mask, moisturiser and sunscreen finish.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.suits: Skin in the late 20s and above with early lines.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.ask: you are pregnant, have a sunburn or open skin.
wsvc.anti-ageing-facial.care: Sunscreen daily and a night cream; results build over sessions.
wsvc.aroma-facial.name: Aroma Facial
wsvc.aroma-facial.line: A calming facial built around essential oils.
wsvc.aroma-facial.what: A gentle facial using essential oils for scent and relaxation. It is the most soothing facial in the menu, with the focus on calm rather than correction.
wsvc.aroma-facial.good: Stress, dull skin and anyone who loves a relaxing treatment.
wsvc.aroma-facial.why: Scent and slow massage ease tension and leave skin calm and glowing.
wsvc.aroma-facial.step1: We choose a calming oil blend with you.
wsvc.aroma-facial.step2: The face is cleansed and massaged slowly with the oils.
wsvc.aroma-facial.step3: A soothing mask and moisturiser finish.
wsvc.aroma-facial.ask: you are allergic to essential oils, have acne or very reactive skin.
wsvc.aroma-facial.care: Rest after the session; use a gentle moisturiser.
wsvc.stomach-wax.name: Stomach Wax
wsvc.stomach-wax.line: Smooth, fine hair removed from the abdomen.
wsvc.stomach-wax.what: Fine hair on the stomach and the line below the navel is removed with a gentle wax.
wsvc.stomach-wax.why: Waxing removes fine hair at the root so skin stays smooth longer than with shaving.
wsvc.stomach-wax.step1: We prepare the skin and test the wax.
wsvc.stomach-wax.step2: Wax is applied in small sections and removed.
wsvc.stomach-wax.ask: you are pregnant, have a rash or recent surgery on the area.
wsvc.stomach-wax.care: Loose clothes for 24 hours; no hot baths.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.name: Sugar Wax (Legs)
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.line: Sugaring: a gentle, natural paste for leg hair.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.what: A sticky paste of sugar, lemon and water is rolled on and flicked off in the direction of hair growth. Compared with warm wax, it grips hair and not skin, and is washable.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.good: Sensitive skin and those who prefer natural ingredients.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.why: Because sugar removes hair in the direction it grows, there is less breakage and fewer ingrown hairs.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.step1: We test the paste temperature on your skin.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.step2: The paste is applied and removed in the direction of hair growth.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.step3: We rinse residue with water and moisturise.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.suits: Sensitive skin, ingrown-prone skin and natural-product fans.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.ask: you have a sugar allergy, cuts, varicose veins or sunburn.
wsvc.sugar-wax-legs.care: Exfoliate gently after 3 days and moisturise daily.
wsvc.full-body-wax.name: Full Body Wax
wsvc.full-body-wax.line: Arms, legs, underarms and more in one booking.
wsvc.full-body-wax.what: A complete wax: full arms, full legs, underarms and the stomach or back, with the bikini line optional. Booked together it saves time compared with separate services.
wsvc.full-body-wax.good: A trip, a wedding or a seasonal reset.
wsvc.full-body-wax.why: Doing everything in one visit keeps regrowth even and saves several trips.
wsvc.full-body-wax.step1: We discuss the areas and test the wax.
wsvc.full-body-wax.step2: Each area is waxed in turn with rests as needed.
wsvc.full-body-wax.suits: Anyone preparing for an event or travel.
wsvc.full-body-wax.ask: you have a skin condition, sunburn, or are pregnant (ask first).
wsvc.full-body-wax.care: Moisturise daily and avoid saunas and tight clothes for a day.
wsvc.gel-extensions.name: Gel Nail Extensions
wsvc.gel-extensions.line: Longer nails that stay flexible and light.
wsvc.gel-extensions.what: Soft gel or a pre-shaped gel tip is built and cured under a lamp for length. Compared with acrylic, it is lighter, more flexible and has less odour, but is less rigid.
wsvc.gel-extensions.good: Those who want natural-looking length without heavy nails.
wsvc.gel-extensions.why: Gel gives a glossy, natural look and bends with the nail, so it feels more comfortable.
wsvc.gel-extensions.step1: We prep the nails and choose the length.
wsvc.gel-extensions.step2: Gel is applied, shaped and cured in layers.
wsvc.gel-extensions.step3: Colour and top coat are applied.
wsvc.gel-extensions.suits: Short, weak or soft nails; natural-looking length.
wsvc.gel-extensions.ask: you have a nail infection or a gel allergy.
wsvc.gel-extensions.care: Do not peel off; refill every 3 weeks.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.name: Cat-Eye Nails
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.line: A shimmering line that moves like a cat’s eye.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.what: A magnetic gel polish is cured with a magnet so a shimmering band of light shifts across each nail. It is different from chrome: the shine is a moving line rather than an all-over mirror.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.good: A dramatic look for parties and festivals.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.why: The moving shimmer looks different from every angle and suits both short and long nails.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.step1: We shape the nails and apply a dark base.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.step2: Magnetic gel is applied and shaped with a magnet, then cured.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.step3: A top coat seals the shine.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.suits: Short or long nails; dark bases show it best.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.ask: you have thin, peeling nails or a gel allergy.
wsvc.cat-eye-nails.care: Avoid harsh cleaners; do not peel the gel.
wsvc.french-pedicure.name: French Pedicure
wsvc.french-pedicure.line: A clean, classic white-tip toenail finish.
wsvc.french-pedicure.what: A full pedicure followed by a pale pink or nude base with crisp white tips on the toes. It combines foot care with the classic French finish.
wsvc.french-pedicure.good: Weddings, sandals and a neat, timeless look.
wsvc.french-pedicure.why: The classic tips make toes look neat and go with every outfit.
wsvc.french-pedicure.step2: A nude base and white tips are painted.
wsvc.french-pedicure.step3: A top coat and foot massage finish.
wsvc.french-pedicure.suits: Anyone who likes a clean, classic look.
wsvc.french-pedicure.ask: you have a fungal infection, open sores or diabetes (ask first).
wsvc.french-pedicure.care: Moisturise feet nightly; reapply top coat if needed.
wsvc.swedish-massage.name: Swedish Massage
wsvc.swedish-massage.line: Long, flowing strokes for gentle full-body relaxation.
wsvc.swedish-massage.what: Light to medium pressure with long gliding strokes, kneading and circular movements. It is gentler than a deep tissue massage and aims at relaxation rather than releasing deep knots.
wsvc.swedish-massage.why: Gentle, flowing strokes improve circulation and calm the nervous system.
wsvc.swedish-massage.step1: We agree the pressure and warm the oil.
wsvc.swedish-massage.step2: Long strokes and kneading cover the back, arms and legs.
wsvc.swedish-massage.step3: We finish with light strokes and a short rest.
wsvc.swedish-massage.suits: Anyone new to massage; mild to moderate tension.
wsvc.swedish-massage.ask: you are pregnant, ill or have an injury (ask first).
wsvc.swedish-massage.care: Drink water and rest; avoid a heavy meal for an hour.
wsvc.thai-massage.name: Thai Massage
wsvc.thai-massage.line: Stretching and pressure, done over loose clothing.
wsvc.thai-massage.what: The therapist uses palms, thumbs and gentle stretches to work along energy lines, with no oil and with you in loose clothing. It is more active than Swedish massage.
wsvc.thai-massage.good: Stiff joints, poor flexibility and desk workers.
wsvc.thai-massage.why: Stretching with rhythmic pressure improves flexibility and releases tightness.
wsvc.thai-massage.step1: We discuss areas of stiffness and any limits.
wsvc.thai-massage.step2: Pressure and assisted stretches work through the legs, back and arms.
wsvc.thai-massage.step3: We finish with gentle stretches and rest.
wsvc.thai-massage.ask: you have joint problems, osteoporosis, are pregnant or recently injured (ask first).
wsvc.thai-massage.care: Drink water; mild stiffness for a day is normal.
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.name: Lymphatic Drainage Massage
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.line: A very light massage that reduces puffiness.
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.what: Very gentle, rhythmic strokes follow the lymph pathways to reduce fluid build-up and puffiness. The pressure is much lighter than any other massage in the menu.
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.good: Puffy face, heavy legs and after travel or long standing.
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.why: Gentle drainage helps swollen, heavy areas feel lighter and look slimmer.
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.step1: We explain the light touch and warm the oil.
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.step2: Slow, feather-light strokes move fluid towards the lymph nodes.
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.suits: Puffiness, water retention and tired legs.
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.ask: you have an infection, blood clots, heart or kidney problems (see a doctor first).
wsvc.lymphatic-massage.care: Drink water and keep legs raised; avoid salty food that day.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.name: Airbrush Makeup
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.line: A feather-light, seamless base sprayed on.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.what: The foundation is applied with an airbrush as a fine mist, giving a very thin, even finish that photographs flawlessly. It is lighter and more seamless than brush-applied HD makeup.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.good: Weddings, HD video and long events.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.why: Airbrush layers are so thin that skin looks natural and the makeup lasts hours without caking.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.step1: We prep the skin and match the shade.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.step2: A fine mist of foundation is sprayed in thin layers.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.step3: Eyes, lips and cheeks are finished by hand and set.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.suits: Brides, HD cameras and anyone who wants light-feeling coverage.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.ask: you have an active breakout or are allergic to makeup products.
wsvc.airbrush-makeup.care: Cleanse well at night with an oil cleanser.
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.name: Smokey Eye Makeup
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.what: Dark shadows are blended from the lash line outwards for a soft, smoky shape. It is bolder than plain eye makeup, with stronger depth and more blending.
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.good: Evening parties, weddings and a dramatic look.
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.why: A smokey eye makes eyes look larger and deeper, and pairs well with a soft lip.
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.step1: We pick the shade, black, brown, or a coloured smoke.
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.step2: Shadows are layered and blended with liner and lashes.
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.step3: We set it so the smoke does not smudge.
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.suits: All eye shapes; hooded and almond eyes especially.
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.ask: you have eye irritation or are allergic to eye products.
wsvc.smokey-eye-makeup.care: Remove with an oil-based remover; do not sleep in it.
wsvc.soft-glam-makeup.name: Soft Glam Makeup
wsvc.soft-glam-makeup.what: A satin base, soft contour, warm shimmer on the eyes and a glossy lip give a polished finish that is softer than full glam and more finished than natural makeup.
wsvc.soft-glam-makeup.why: Soft glam sits between natural and full glam: it looks polished without looking heavy.
wsvc.soft-glam-makeup.step1: We prep the skin and match the base.
wsvc.soft-glam-makeup.step2: A satin base, soft contour, shimmer and a glossy lip are applied.
wsvc.soft-glam-makeup.step3: We set it with a light finishing spray.
wsvc.soft-glam-makeup.ask: you have an active breakout or a product allergy.
wsvc.hair-trim.name: Hair Trim
wsvc.hair-trim.line: A tidy-up that removes split ends and keeps your length.
wsvc.hair-trim.what: Only the damaged ends are cut, about half an inch to an inch, with no change to the style or length.
wsvc.hair-trim.good: Anyone growing hair out, or keeping a long style healthy.
wsvc.hair-trim.why: Split ends travel up the hair and cause breakage; a regular trim stops that and lets hair grow longer and healthier.
wsvc.hair-trim.step1: We check the ends and agree how much to take off.
wsvc.hair-trim.step2: Hair is combed straight and the ends are cut evenly.
wsvc.hair-trim.step3: We dry the hair and check the line.
wsvc.hair-trim.suits: All hair types, especially long hair.
wsvc.hair-trim.ask: you want a new shape or a big change (choose a cut instead).
wsvc.hair-trim.care: Trim every 6–8 weeks; use a serum on the ends.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.name: Curtain Bangs
wsvc.curtain-bangs.line: Soft, centre-parted bangs that sweep to the sides.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.what: A longer fringe is parted in the middle and swept to either side like curtains. It is softer and easier to grow out than full, straight-across bangs.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.good: Anyone who wants a fringe without the commitment.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.why: Curtain bangs frame the cheekbones and blend into the rest of the hair as they grow.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.step1: We check your hairline, parting and forehead.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.step2: The front section is cut longer in the middle and sloped down the sides.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.step3: We blow-dry outwards to set the curve.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.suits: Round, long, square and heart faces; straight or wavy hair.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.ask: you have a strong cowlick or very curly hair at the front.
wsvc.curtain-bangs.care: Blow-dry the bangs outwards each morning; trim every 4–6 weeks.
wsvc.hair-extensions.name: Hair Extensions
wsvc.hair-extensions.line: Instant length and volume with added hair.
wsvc.hair-extensions.what: Strands or wefts of real or quality hair are attached to your own hair for extra length or fullness. They are added without cutting your hair.
wsvc.hair-extensions.good: Thin or short hair, and special events.
wsvc.hair-extensions.why: Extensions give length and volume at once, with no wait for hair to grow.
wsvc.hair-extensions.step1: We match the colour and texture to your hair.
wsvc.hair-extensions.step2: Extensions are attached in sections close to the roots.
wsvc.hair-extensions.step3: We blend them with a trim and style.
wsvc.hair-extensions.suits: Fine, short or thin hair; weddings and events.
wsvc.hair-extensions.ask: your hair is very damaged, or you have a scalp condition.
wsvc.hair-extensions.care: Brush gently from the ends; do not sleep with wet hair.
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.name: Dandruff Treatment
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.line: Clears flakes and calms an itchy scalp.
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.what: A medicated or anti-fungal cleanse, scalp massage and a soothing mask are used to loosen flakes and reduce the yeast that causes dandruff.
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.why: Dandruff comes back unless the scalp is treated, not just washed; a course keeps it under control.
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.step1: We look at the scalp to tell dandruff from dryness.
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.step2: A treatment shampoo and scalp massage loosen flakes.
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.step3: A soothing mask is applied and rinsed.
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.suits: Flaky, itchy scalp with white flakes.
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.ask: you have red, painful or weeping patches (see a doctor).
wsvc.dandruff-treatment.care: Use the recommended shampoo; do not scratch the scalp.
wsvc.eyelash-extensions.name: Eyelash Extensions
wsvc.eyelash-extensions.what: Individual synthetic lashes are attached one by one to each natural lash for added length, curl and fullness that last for weeks.
wsvc.eyelash-extensions.good: Anyone who wants defined eyes without daily mascara.
wsvc.eyelash-extensions.why: Lash extensions open and frame the eyes and save morning time.
wsvc.eyelash-extensions.step1: We cleanse the lashes and agree the length and curl.
wsvc.eyelash-extensions.step2: Each extension is attached to a single natural lash.
wsvc.eyelash-extensions.step3: We check the set and brush it into shape.
wsvc.eyelash-extensions.ask: you have eye irritation, an infection or are allergic to the glue.
wsvc.eyelash-extensions.care: Keep dry for 24 hours; do not rub or use oil-based removers.
wsvc.diamond-facial.name: Diamond Facial
wsvc.diamond-facial.line: A polishing facial with diamond-dust for a luminous glow.
wsvc.diamond-facial.what: A cream and mask with fine diamond-dust polish the skin, and a massage is used to give a brighter, smoother finish. It is a popular choice before weddings and festivals.
wsvc.diamond-facial.good: Dull skin before an event; mature or normal skin.
wsvc.diamond-facial.why: The gentle polishing refines the skin surface and gives an instant luminous look.
wsvc.diamond-facial.step1: We cleanse and steam the skin.
wsvc.diamond-facial.step2: The diamond scrub and massage cream are worked in.
wsvc.diamond-facial.step3: A diamond mask, moisturiser and sunscreen finish.
wsvc.diamond-facial.suits: Dull, tired or normal skin; special occasions.
wsvc.diamond-facial.ask: you have acne, a sunburn, open skin or very sensitive skin.
wsvc.diamond-facial.care: Wear sunscreen; avoid scrubs for 3 days.
wsvc.face-bleach.name: Face Bleach
wsvc.face-bleach.line: Lightens fine facial hair for an even-looking skin tone.
wsvc.face-bleach.what: A mild bleach cream is applied to the face to lighten fine hair and give a brighter, more even look. It does not remove hair, and it is not a skin-whitening treatment.
wsvc.face-bleach.good: Fine, dark facial hair that you want less visible.
wsvc.face-bleach.why: Lightening makes fine hair blend with the skin and makes the face look brighter for a day or two.
wsvc.face-bleach.step1: We patch test and clean the face.
wsvc.face-bleach.step2: The bleach is applied to the face avoiding the eyes.
wsvc.face-bleach.step3: It is removed after the set time and the face is soothed.
wsvc.face-bleach.suits: Fine, dark facial hair on fair to medium skin.
wsvc.face-bleach.ask: you have sensitive skin, acne, sunburn or have used retinoids recently.
wsvc.face-bleach.care: Avoid the sun and scrubs for 24 hours; use sunscreen.
wsvc.nail-polish-change.name: Nail Polish Change
wsvc.nail-polish-change.line: A quick colour refresh on tidy nails.
wsvc.nail-polish-change.what: Old polish is removed, the nails are shaped and buffed, and fresh colour is applied. It is quicker than a full manicure, with no soak or massage.
wsvc.nail-polish-change.good: Anyone who wants fresh colour in a hurry.
wsvc.nail-polish-change.why: A neat colour change makes hands look cared-for in minutes.
wsvc.nail-polish-change.step1: We remove the old polish and shape the nails.
wsvc.nail-polish-change.step2: The nails are buffed and a base coat is applied.
wsvc.nail-polish-change.step3: Two coats of colour and a top coat finish.
wsvc.nail-polish-change.ask: you have a nail infection or a cut on the fingers.
wsvc.nail-polish-change.care: Avoid water for an hour; use cuticle oil daily.
wsvc.reflexology.name: Foot Reflexology
wsvc.reflexology.line: Pressure-point foot work that relaxes the whole body.
wsvc.reflexology.what: The therapist presses specific points on the feet that are believed to link to different parts of the body. It is more targeted than a plain foot massage.
wsvc.reflexology.good: Tired feet, stress and poor sleep.
wsvc.reflexology.why: Pressure on the feet relaxes tension and many people sleep better afterwards.
wsvc.reflexology.step1: We soak the feet and explain the pressure.
wsvc.reflexology.step2: Each foot is worked point by point with firm pressure.
wsvc.reflexology.step3: We finish with gentle strokes and a warm towel.
wsvc.reflexology.suits: Stress, tired feet and general tension.
wsvc.reflexology.ask: you are pregnant, have a foot injury, clots, or neuropathy (ask first).
wsvc.reflexology.care: Drink water and rest; mild tenderness for a day is normal.
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.name: Bridal Hairstyle
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.line: A bridal updo or styled look planned with the outfit.
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.what: A bun, braid, curls or half-up style, built to hold all day and to suit the outfit, jewellery and veil. It is a full style, more planned than a party hairstyle.
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.why: The hair has to stay perfect for hours and look good from every photo angle.
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.step1: We discuss the outfit, jewellery and any veil or flowers.
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.step2: Hair is prepped, built and pinned in the chosen style.
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.step3: We set with spray and add accessories.
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.suits: Brides; book a trial before the day.
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.ask: you have a scalp irritation or very short hair (extensions may help).
wsvc.bridal-hairstyle.care: Wash and dry hair the night before; avoid heavy conditioners.
wsvc.mehndi-design.name: Mehndi (Henna) Design
wsvc.mehndi-design.line: Henna patterns for hands and feet.
wsvc.mehndi-design.what: Natural henna paste is applied in traditional, Arabic or modern patterns on the hands and feet, and left to dry and stain the skin a rich brown-red.
wsvc.mehndi-design.why: Mehndi is part of many celebrations and its rich colour deepens over a day or two.
wsvc.mehndi-design.step1: We choose a pattern and size with you.
wsvc.mehndi-design.step2: Henna paste is applied by hand and left to dry.
wsvc.mehndi-design.step3: We seal it with a lemon-sugar mix and show you how to keep it on.
wsvc.mehndi-design.suits: Anyone celebrating a festival or wedding.
wsvc.mehndi-design.ask: you are allergic to henna, or have broken skin on the hands or feet.
wsvc.mehndi-design.care: Keep it on for 6–8 hours; avoid water and apply a little oil.
wsvc.lob-cut.name: Lob (Long Bob)
wsvc.lob-cut.line: A bob that grazes the collarbone.
wsvc.lob-cut.what: A blunt or softly layered cut that ends between the chin and the shoulders, a little longer than a classic bob. It is easier to tie back than a bob.
wsvc.lob-cut.good: Anyone who wants a fresh cut but is not ready to go short.
wsvc.lob-cut.why: The lob is a safe, flattering step from long hair that still moves and can be tied up.
wsvc.lob-cut.step1: We choose the length: collarbone or just above.
wsvc.lob-cut.step2: Hair is cut in sections to a clean line, with optional soft layers.
wsvc.lob-cut.step3: We blow-dry to show the shape.
wsvc.lob-cut.suits: Straight and wavy hair; most face shapes.
wsvc.lob-cut.ask: your hair is very curly and you want to keep length.
wsvc.lob-cut.care: Trim every 6–8 weeks to keep the line sharp.
wsvc.wolf-cut.name: Wolf Cut
wsvc.wolf-cut.line: A mix of shag and mullet, voluminous on top and wispy at the ends.
wsvc.wolf-cut.what: Heavy, short layers at the crown blend into longer, wispy lengths. It is wilder than a shag, with more contrast between the short top and the long back.
wsvc.wolf-cut.good: Thick or wavy hair, and an edgy, textured look.
wsvc.wolf-cut.why: The wolf cut adds big volume and movement and looks styled even when messy.
wsvc.wolf-cut.step1: We plan where the short crown layers start.
wsvc.wolf-cut.step2: Short layers are cut on top and blended into long, razored ends.
wsvc.wolf-cut.step3: We style with texture spray for the tousled finish.
wsvc.wolf-cut.suits: Wavy, thick or medium hair; round, oval and square faces.
wsvc.wolf-cut.ask: your hair is very fine or straight and flat, or you want a neat look.
wsvc.wolf-cut.care: Use a texture spray; trim every 6–8 weeks to keep the shape.
wsvc.hime-cut.name: Hime Cut
wsvc.hime-cut.line: Straight cheek-length sides with a blunt fringe and long back.
wsvc.hime-cut.what: Long, straight hair with face-framing sidelocks cut at cheek or chin length and a straight fringe. It is a sharp, graphic shape, different from a layered cut.
wsvc.hime-cut.good: Long, straight, glossy hair and an elegant, structured look.
wsvc.hime-cut.why: The hime cut frames the face with clean lines and makes straight hair look deliberate.
wsvc.hime-cut.step1: We choose the length of the side pieces and the fringe.
wsvc.hime-cut.step2: The fringe and sidelocks are cut in sharp lines, the back kept long.
wsvc.hime-cut.step3: We straighten and smooth the lines.
wsvc.hime-cut.suits: Straight hair; oval, heart and long faces.
wsvc.hime-cut.ask: your hair is very wavy or curly, or you dislike a fringe.
wsvc.hime-cut.care: Trim the fringe every 3–4 weeks; keep hair sleek with serum.
wsvc.bixie-cut.name: Bixie Cut
wsvc.bixie-cut.line: A soft in-between of a pixie and a bob.
wsvc.bixie-cut.what: Short, layered hair a little longer than a pixie and shorter than a bob, with wispy layers and soft fringe. It is softer and more grow-out friendly than a full pixie.
wsvc.bixie-cut.good: Anyone who wants short hair but not a very short cut.
wsvc.bixie-cut.why: The bixie gives the ease of short hair with enough length to style and tuck.
wsvc.bixie-cut.step1: We decide the length at the ear or jaw.
wsvc.bixie-cut.step2: Layers are cut short at the crown and longer at the sides.
wsvc.bixie-cut.step3: We style with a light product to show the texture.
wsvc.bixie-cut.suits: Fine to medium hair; oval, heart and long faces.
wsvc.bixie-cut.ask: you want a very short, sharp pixie or long hair.
wsvc.bixie-cut.care: Trim every 5–7 weeks to keep the shape.
wsvc.beach-waves.name: Beach Waves
wsvc.beach-waves.line: Loose, tousled waves with a relaxed finish.
wsvc.beach-waves.what: Hair is waved with a wand or iron in alternating directions and finished with salt or texture spray for soft, undone waves. It is looser and messier than tong curls.
wsvc.beach-waves.why: Beach waves give volume and an easy, lived-in look that suits most outfits.
wsvc.beach-waves.step1: We prep with a heat protectant.
wsvc.beach-waves.step2: Sections are waved loosely, leaving the ends out.
wsvc.beach-waves.step3: We shake out the waves and set with texture spray.
wsvc.beach-waves.suits: Straight or slightly wavy hair; medium to long.
wsvc.beach-waves.ask: your hair is very short or very curly.
wsvc.beach-waves.care: Do not brush the waves; sleep with a loose braid to refresh them.
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.name: Sleek Straight Styling
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.line: Glass-smooth, shiny straight hair for the day.
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.what: Hair is blow-dried and flat-ironed into a smooth, glossy, straight finish. It lasts until the next wash, unlike a straightening treatment.
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.good: Events, photos and anyone wanting poker-straight hair for a day.
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.why: A sleek finish makes hair look healthy and polished, and works with every outfit.
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.step1: We wash and apply a heat protectant.
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.step2: Hair is dried smooth and then flat-ironed in thin sections.
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.suits: Straight, wavy or curly hair; all lengths from the chin.
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.ask: your hair is very damaged or you need long-lasting straightening (choose a treatment instead).
wsvc.sleek-straight-styling.care: Avoid humidity and rain; keep hair dry until the next wash.
wsvc.perm-waves.name: Perm (Curl Set)
wsvc.perm-waves.line: Long-lasting curls or waves set into straight hair.
wsvc.perm-waves.what: A curling lotion and rods or heat are used to set curls or soft waves that last for months. It is the opposite of rebonding, which straightens.
wsvc.perm-waves.good: Straight hair that wants lasting body, curls or waves.
wsvc.perm-waves.why: A perm gives lasting volume and shape without daily styling.
wsvc.perm-waves.step1: We choose the curl size and test the hair.
wsvc.perm-waves.step2: Hair is rolled on rods and the perm lotion is applied.
wsvc.perm-waves.step3: We neutralise, rinse and style the curls.
wsvc.perm-waves.suits: Healthy, straight or fine hair that lacks body.
wsvc.perm-waves.ask: your hair is damaged, coloured many times, or you are pregnant.
wsvc.perm-waves.care: No washing for 48 hours; use curl cream and a mask weekly.
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.name: Half-Up Hairstyle
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.line: Top half pinned up, the rest left flowing.
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.what: The upper section is gathered and pinned or twisted, with the lower hair left down, curled or straight. It is easier and quicker than a full updo.
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.good: Weddings guests, parties and anyone wanting hair off the face.
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.why: It keeps hair off the face and shows off the length, and works with most necklines.
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.step1: We prep the hair and choose the style.
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.step2: The top section is lifted, twisted or braided and pinned.
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.step3: The lower hair is styled and set with spray.
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.suits: Medium to long hair; all face shapes.
wsvc.half-up-hairstyle.care: Remove pins gently; brush from the ends.
wsvc.nanoplastia.name: Nanoplastia
wsvc.nanoplastia.line: Smoothing with amino acids, usually without formaldehyde.
wsvc.nanoplastia.what: A smoothing treatment that uses amino acids and plant-based ingredients, sealed with a flat iron, to straighten and shine. It is gentler and softer than a classic keratin treatment and leaves more natural movement.
wsvc.nanoplastia.good: Frizzy or wavy hair that you want smoother and glossier.
wsvc.nanoplastia.why: It gives smooth, glossy hair with a more natural, less stiff finish than rebonding.
wsvc.nanoplastia.step1: We wash and check your hair and scalp.
wsvc.nanoplastia.step2: The treatment is applied in sections and sealed with heat.
wsvc.nanoplastia.suits: Frizzy, dull, wavy or chemically treated hair.
wsvc.nanoplastia.ask: you are pregnant, have a sensitive scalp or very damaged hair.
wsvc.nanoplastia.care: No washing for 3 days; use sulphate-free shampoo.
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.name: Cysteine Treatment
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.line: Smoothing that softens frizz while keeping a natural wave.
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.what: A treatment using an amino acid, cysteine, to relax frizz and give a soft, smooth finish. It is milder and shorter-lasting than rebonding and gives less change in shape than keratin.
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.good: Frizzy hair that wants softness without full straightness.
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.why: It tames frizz and softens hair while leaving natural movement.
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.step1: We wash the hair and check its condition.
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.step2: The treatment is applied in sections and sealed with a flat iron.
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.suits: Frizzy, dull or lightly wavy hair.
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.ask: you are pregnant, have a sensitive scalp or very damaged hair.
wsvc.cysteine-treatment.care: No washing for 3 days; use sulphate-free shampoo.
wsvc.split-end-treatment.name: Split-End Treatment
wsvc.split-end-treatment.line: Seals split ends to make hair look smoother until the next trim.
wsvc.split-end-treatment.what: A sealing treatment with serums and gentle heat bonds the frayed ends together for a smoother look. It does not repair ends for good, but it helps until you can trim.
wsvc.split-end-treatment.good: Long hair you are not ready to cut, with frayed ends.
wsvc.split-end-treatment.why: It improves the look and feel of ends and slows further splitting while you grow out.
wsvc.split-end-treatment.step1: We wash the hair and check the ends.
wsvc.split-end-treatment.step2: A sealing serum is worked into the ends and set with gentle heat.
wsvc.split-end-treatment.ask: your ends are badly damaged (a trim will help more).
wsvc.split-end-treatment.care: Still trim every 8–10 weeks; use a leave-in serum on the ends.
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.name: Herbal Hair Spa
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.line: A spa with plant extracts such as amla, hibiscus and onion.
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.what: A hair spa that uses herbal oils and masks, such as amla, hibiscus or onion, in place of regular products. It is a more natural take on a classic hair spa.
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.good: Dry hair and scalp, hair fall, and those who prefer herbal care.
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.why: Herbal ingredients nourish the scalp and condition the hair without heavy chemicals.
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.step1: We choose the herbal blend with you and check allergies.
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.step2: The herbal oil is massaged in and a herbal mask is steamed.
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.suits: Dry, dull hair and a tired scalp.
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.ask: you are allergic to herbs, onion or oils, or have a scalp wound.
wsvc.herbal-hair-spa.care: Avoid washing for 24 hours; repeat every 3–4 weeks.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.name: Ampoule Treatment
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.line: A concentrated serum shot for a specific hair concern.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.what: A small, concentrated ampoule of active ingredients is massaged into the scalp or lengths to target one concern, such as hair fall, dryness or dullness. It is quicker and more concentrated than a mask.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.good: A busy visit when you want a targeted boost.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.often: Every 2–4 weeks, or a weekly course
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.why: A concentrated dose targets one concern in a short time, and is a good add-on to a wash or cut.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.step1: We pick the ampoule for your main concern.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.step2: The ampoule is massaged into the scalp or lengths.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.step3: It is left briefly, then we dry and style.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.suits: Dry, weak or dull hair, or a weak scalp.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.ask: you are allergic to the ingredients or have a scalp wound.
wsvc.ampoule-treatment.care: Follow with a gentle shampoo; a course shows more than one use.
wsvc.baby-bangs.name: Baby Bangs
wsvc.baby-bangs.line: Very short, cropped bangs above the brows.
wsvc.baby-bangs.what: A short fringe cut around the middle of the forehead, much shorter than curtain bangs or a standard fringe. It makes a bold, fashion-led statement.
wsvc.baby-bangs.good: Those who want a bold change and have a forehead and hairline that suit it.
wsvc.baby-bangs.why: Baby bangs frame the eyes and give a distinctive, playful look on straight or lightly wavy hair.
wsvc.baby-bangs.step1: We check your hairline, cowlick and forehead height.
wsvc.baby-bangs.step2: The fringe is cut dry in small steps to avoid going too short.
wsvc.baby-bangs.step3: We style it so you can see how it sits.
wsvc.baby-bangs.suits: Straight hair, oval, heart and long faces with a strong hairline.
wsvc.baby-bangs.ask: you have a high forehead you want to keep covered, a strong cowlick or very curly front hair.
wsvc.baby-bangs.care: Needs a trim every 3–4 weeks; wash the fringe separately if oily.
wsvc.root-smudge.name: Root Smudge (Shadow Root)
wsvc.root-smudge.line: A soft, blended dark root that grows out gracefully.
wsvc.root-smudge.what: The roots are tinted to a shade close to your natural colour and blended into lighter lengths, so there is no hard line between root and colour. It is a finishing step, different from a full balayage.
wsvc.root-smudge.good: Blonde or highlighted hair that you want to grow out without a visible regrowth line.
wsvc.root-smudge.why: A smudged root makes lightened hair look deeper and more natural and means fewer touch-ups.
wsvc.root-smudge.step1: We choose a root shade close to your natural colour.
wsvc.root-smudge.step2: Colour is applied at the roots and softly blended into the lengths.
wsvc.root-smudge.ask: you want bright roots all the way to the scalp.
wsvc.root-smudge.care: Use colour-safe shampoo; refresh every 10–14 weeks.
wsvc.copper-colour.name: Copper Hair Colour
wsvc.copper-colour.line: A warm, glowing copper from soft ginger to rich auburn.
wsvc.copper-colour.what: An all-over warm red-orange colour, from light copper to deep auburn, usually after lightening dark hair. It has more warmth than a mahogany or a henna shade.
wsvc.copper-colour.good: Warm, fair to medium skin tones that suit warm shades.
wsvc.copper-colour.why: Copper is a standout colour that looks rich in daylight and fades gracefully into soft orange.
wsvc.copper-colour.step1: We choose the depth of copper for your skin tone.
wsvc.copper-colour.step2: Hair is lightened if needed, then the copper colour is applied.
wsvc.copper-colour.suits: Healthy hair; those who enjoy a warm, bold colour.
wsvc.copper-colour.ask: your hair is damaged, or you want a low-maintenance colour.
wsvc.copper-colour.care: Use colour-safe shampoo and cool water; red fades fastest.
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.name: Blonde (Bleach & Tone)
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.line: A full, even blonde from root to tip.
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.what: The whole head is lightened with bleach and then toned to the blonde you want, from warm honey to cool platinum. It is a major change, much more than highlights or balayage.
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.good: Anyone ready for a full blonde and its upkeep.
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.why: A full blonde gives a clean, bright, even finish, but it needs careful lightening and aftercare.
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.step1: We assess your hair and talk through the realistic shade.
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.step2: Hair is lightened in stages, then toned.
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.suits: Healthy, strong hair; commitment to upkeep.
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.ask: your hair is already damaged or coloured dark with henna or box dye (a test is needed).
wsvc.blonde-bleach-tone.care: Use purple shampoo and bond care; roots need touching up every 4–6 weeks.
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.name: Rich Brunette Colour
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.line: A glossy, deep brown with warmth and shine.
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.what: An all-over brown colour, from chocolate to espresso or cool chestnut, applied with a gloss for a deep, shiny finish. It adds richness to dull or faded dark hair.
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.good: Dull black or faded brown hair, and those wanting a polished natural look.
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.why: A rich brunette gives depth and shine while staying natural and low-risk.
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.step1: We choose a brown that suits your skin tone: warm, neutral or cool.
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.step2: Colour is applied all over and rinsed, then a gloss seals it.
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.suits: Dark to medium hair; most skin tones.
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.ask: you want a very light colour or visible contrast.
wsvc.rich-brunette-colour.care: Use colour-safe shampoo; refresh the gloss every 6–8 weeks.
